package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.avs.visitapp.R
import com.avs.visitapp.model.BankVisitData

class BankVisitAdapter(
    private var visits: List<BankVisitData>,
    private val onItemClicked: (BankVisitData) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<BankVisitAdapter.BankVisitViewHolder>() {

    private var currentTab: String = "Pending"

    fun updateList(newVisits: List<BankVisitData>) {
        visits = newVisits
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    fun setCurrentTab(tabName: String) {
        currentTab = tabName
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): BankVisitViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.item_bank_visit, parent, false)
        return BankVisitViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: BankVisitViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val visit = visits[position]

        holder.tvBankName.text = "Bank: ${visit.BankName ?: "N/A"}"
        holder.tvBranchName.text = "Branch: ${visit.BranchName ?: "N/A"}"

        val timeStr = if (currentTab == "Done") {
            "${visit.VisitDate?.substringBefore("T")} | In: ${visit.VisitInTime} | Out: ${visit.VisitOutTime}"
        } else {
            "${visit.VisitDate?.substringBefore("T")} | In: ${visit.VisitInTime}"
        }
        holder.tvDateAndTime.text = timeStr

        holder.tvAddress.text = "Address: ${visit.FullAddress ?: "N/A"}"
        holder.tvComments.text = "Comments: ${visit.Comments ?: "None"}"

        // If in Pending tab, whole card is clickable to open Update Form
        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener {
            if (currentTab == "Pending") {
                onItemClicked(visit)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = visits.size

    class BankVisitViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvBankName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBankName)
        val tvBranchName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBranchName)
        val tvDateAndTime: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvDateAndTime)
        val tvAddress: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAddress)
        val tvComments: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvComments)
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.avs.visitapp.R
import com.avs.visitapp.Visit
class CustomerAdapter(
    private var visits: List<Visit>,
    private val onVisitClicked: (Visit) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<CustomerAdapter.CustomerViewHolder>() {

    private var currentTab: String = "Pending"

    fun setCurrentTab(tab: String) {
        currentTab = tab
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    class CustomerViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvName)
        val tvMobile: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvMobile)
        val tvBranch: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBranchName)
        val tvStatus: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvStatus)
        val ODAmt: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvoverdue)
        val LoanAccNo: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLoanAc)
        val Remark: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvRemark)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): CustomerViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_customer, parent, false)
        return CustomerViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: CustomerViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val visit = visits[position]

        holder.tvName.text = visit.CustomerName
        holder.tvMobile.text = visit.CustMobileNo ?: ""
        holder.tvBranch.text = visit.BranchName
        holder.ODAmt.text = visit.ODAmt ?: ""
        holder.LoanAccNo.text = visit.LoanAccNo ?: ""
        holder.Remark.text = visit.CallRemarks ?: ""

        // ---- FIXED STATUS HANDLING ----
        when (currentTab) {
            "Pending" -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = "Pending"
                holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.red))
            }
            "VisitAgain" -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = "Visit Again"
                holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.orange))
            }
            "Done" -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = "Done"
                holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.color_green))
            }
        }

        holder.tvMobile.setOnClickListener {
            if (currentTab == "Pending") {
                if (!visit.CustMobileNo.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    onVisitClicked(visit)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = visits.size

    fun updateList(newList: List<Visit>) {
        visits = newList
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView

class DashboardAdapter(
    private val items: List<Dashboard.DashboardItem>,
    private val itemClickListener: (Dashboard.DashboardItem, Int) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<DashboardAdapter.DashboardViewHolder>() {

    inner class DashboardViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val icon: ImageView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.itemIcon)
        val label: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.itemLabel)
        val card: CardView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.itemCard)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): DashboardViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.dashboard_item, parent, false)
        return DashboardViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: DashboardViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val item = items[position]
        holder.icon.setImageResource(item.iconRes)
        holder.label.text = item.label
        holder.card.setOnClickListener {
            itemClickListener(item, position)
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size
}

package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.avs.visitapp.R
import com.avs.visitapp.Visit

class LegalCaseCustomerAdapter(private var visits: List<Visit>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<LegalCaseCustomerAdapter.CustomerViewHolder>() {

    class CustomerViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvName)
        val tvMobile: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvMobile)
        val tvBranch: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBranchName)
        val tvStatus: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvStatus)
        val LoanAccNo: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLoanAc)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): CustomerViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_monitoring_customer, parent, false)
        return CustomerViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: CustomerViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val visit = visits[position]

        // Bind data
        holder.tvName.text = visit.CustomerName
        holder.tvMobile.text = visit.CustMobileNo
        holder.tvBranch.text = visit.BranchName
        holder.tvStatus.text = visit.status
        holder.LoanAccNo.text = visit.LoanAccNo

        val colorRes = when (visit.status.trim().lowercase()) {
            "pending" -> R.color.red
            "done" -> R.color.color_green
            else -> R.color.black
        }
        holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, colorRes))
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = visits.size

    fun updateList(newList: List<Visit>) {
        visits = newList
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.avs.visitapp.R
import com.avs.visitapp.Visit

class MonitoringCustomerAdapter(private var visits: List<Visit>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<MonitoringCustomerAdapter.CustomerViewHolder>() {

    class CustomerViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvName)
        val tvMobile: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvMobile)
//        val tvAddress: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAddress)
        val tvBranch: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBranchName)
        val tvStatus: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvStatus)
        val LoanAccNo: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLoanAc)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): CustomerViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_monitoring_customer, parent, false)
        return CustomerViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: CustomerViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val visit = visits[position]

        // Bind data
        holder.tvName.text = visit.CustomerName
        holder.tvMobile.text = visit.CustMobileNo ?: ""
        holder.tvBranch.text = visit.BranchName
        holder.tvStatus.text = visit.status ?: ""
        holder.LoanAccNo.text = visit.LoanAccNo ?: ""


        val colorRes = when (visit.status?.trim()?.lowercase()) {
            "pending" -> R.color.red
            "done" -> R.color.color_green
            else -> R.color.black
        }
        holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, colorRes))
    }


    override fun getItemCount(): Int = visits.size

    fun updateList(newList: List<Visit>) {
        visits = newList
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter

import android.text.Editable
import android.text.TextWatcher


class SimpleTextWatcher(private val onTextChanged: () -> Unit) : TextWatcher {
    override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
    override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
    override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
        onTextChanged()
    }
}

 : RecyclerView.Adapter<TaskAdapter.TaskViewHolder>() {

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TaskViewHolder, position: Int) {

        val task = taskList[position]

        // User details
        holder.tvUserName.text = "User: ${task.AssignedToName ?: "Unknown"}"
        holder.tvBranch.text = "Branch: ${task.BranchName ?: "Unknown"}"
        holder.tvWork.text = "Work: ${task.TaskDescription}"
        holder.tvTaskDate.text = "Task Date: ${task.TaskDate.take(10)}"

        // 🔥 SHOW/HIDE Completion & Remarks based on MODE
        if (mode == "MY_TASK") {
            holder.tvCompletion.visibility = View.GONE
            holder.tvRemarks.visibility = View.GONE
        } else {
            holder.tvCompletion.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            holder.tvRemarks.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            holder.tvCompletion.text = "Completion: ${task.CompletionDescription ?: "-"}"
            holder.tvRemarks.text = "Remarks: ${task.OtherRemarks ?: "-"}"
        }

        // Status styling
        holder.tvStatus.text = task.Status

        when (task.Status.uppercase()) {
            "PENDING" -> holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(R.color.orange))
            "IN PROGRESS" -> holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(R.color.blue))
            "DONE", "COMPLETED" -> holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(R.color.color_green))
        }

        // Disable only for Assigned By / Assigned To modes
        if (mode == "MY_TASK") {
            holder.itemView.isEnabled = true
            holder.itemView.alpha = 1.0f
        } else {
            holder.itemView.isEnabled = task.Status != "Completed" && task.Status != "DONE"
            holder.itemView.alpha = if (task.Status == "Completed" || task.Status == "DONE") 0.6f else 1.0f
        }


        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener {
            if (task.Status == "Pending" || task.Status == "In Progress") {
                onTaskClick(task)
            }
        }
    }


    override fun getItemCount(): Int = taskList.size

    @SuppressLint("NotifyDataSetChanged")
    fun updateTasks(newTasks: List<TaskModel>) {
        taskList = newTasks
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter


import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.util.Base64
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.avs.visitapp.R
import com.avs.visitapp.VisitData
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.VisitItemRecordBinding
import com.bumptech.glide.Glide
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class VisitAdapter(
    private val visits: List<VisitData>,
    private val onItemClicked: (VisitData) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<VisitAdapter.VisitViewHolder>() {

    inner class VisitViewHolder(val binding: VisitItemRecordBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): VisitViewHolder {
        val binding = VisitItemRecordBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
        return VisitViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: VisitViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val item = visits[position]

        holder.binding.apply {
            // Existing data
            tvName.text = "👤 ${item.Applicant?.Name ?: "N/A"}"

            val rawDate = item.Visit?.VisitDate ?: item.Applicant?.ApplicationDate ?: ""
            val formattedDate = try {
                val inputFormats = listOf(
                    SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()),
                    SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault())
                )
                val outputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
                val parsed = inputFormats.firstNotNullOfOrNull {
                    try {
                        it.parse(rawDate)
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        null
                    }
                }
                outputFormat.format(parsed ?: Date())
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                rawDate
            }
            tvDate.text = formattedDate

            tvDocNo.text = item.Applicant?.ApplicationSerialNo ?: "N/A"

            // Show lat & long from VisitResponses if available (use first one)
            val firstVisitResponse = item.VisitResponses?.firstOrNull()
            if (firstVisitResponse != null) {
                tvLatitude.text = "${firstVisitResponse.location.latitude}"
                tvLongitude.text = "${firstVisitResponse.location.longitude}"
            } else {
                tvLatitude.text = "N/A"
                tvLongitude.text = "N/A"
            }

            // Load photo from VisitResponses photo_url (base64 or URL)
            val photoString = firstVisitResponse?.photo_url
            if (!photoString.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                // Check if base64 or URL (simple heuristic)
                if (photoString.startsWith("http") || photoString.startsWith("https")) {
                    // Load from URL using Glide or Picasso
                    Glide.with(imgVisitPhoto.context)
                        .load(photoString)
                        .placeholder(R.drawable.user_profile)
                        .into(imgVisitPhoto)
                } else {
                    // Assume base64 string, decode and set bitmap
                    val decodedBytes = android.util.Base64.decode(photoString, Base64.DEFAULT)
                    val bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(decodedBytes, 0, decodedBytes.size)
                    imgVisitPhoto.setImageBitmap(bmp)
                }
            } else {
                imgVisitPhoto.setImageResource(R.drawable.user_profile)
            }

            root.setOnClickListener {
                onItemClicked(item)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = visits.size
}

package com.avs.visitapp.Adapter

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.avs.visitapp.R
import com.avs.visitapp.VisitAgainModel

class VisitAgainAdapter(
    private var visits: List<VisitAgainModel>,
    private val onVisitClicked: (VisitAgainModel) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<VisitAgainAdapter.VisitAgainViewHolder>() {

    inner class VisitAgainViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvName)
        val tvMobile: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvMobile)
        val tvBranch: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBranchName)
        val tvOD: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvoverdue)
        val tvLoanAcc: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLoanAc)
        val tvStatus: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvStatus)
        val tvRemark: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvRemark)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): VisitAgainViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_customer, parent, false)
        return VisitAgainViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: VisitAgainViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val visit = visits[position]

        holder.tvName.text = visit.CustomerName ?: ""
        holder.tvMobile.text = visit.CustMobileNo ?: ""
        holder.tvBranch.text = visit.BranchName ?: ""
        holder.tvOD.text = visit.ODAmt ?: ""
        holder.tvLoanAcc.text = visit.LoanAccNo ?: ""

        // Show Comments first, if empty then OtherRemarks
        holder.tvRemark.text = visit.Comments ?: visit.OtherRemarks ?: ""

        when (visit.Status) {
            "Pending" -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = "Pending"
                holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.red))
            }
            "VisitAgain" -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = "Visit Again"
                holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.orange))
            }
            "Done" -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = "Done"
                holder.tvStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.color_green))
            }
            else -> {
                holder.tvStatus.text = visit.Status ?: ""
            }
        }

        // Entire card click
        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener { onVisitClicked(visit) }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = visits.size

    fun updateList(newList: List<VisitAgainModel>) {
        visits = newList
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp

import android.app.DatePickerDialog
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import android.view.View
import android.text.Editable
import android.text.TextWatcher
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.AutoCompleteTextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.ActivityAddTaskBinding
import com.avs.visitapp.model.MyTaskRequest
import com.avs.visitapp.model.TaskInsertRequest
import com.avs.visitapp.model.TaskModel
import com.avs.visitapp.model.User
import okhttp3.ResponseBody
import retrofit2.*
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class AddTaskActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityAddTaskBinding
    private lateinit var apiService: ApiService

    private var selectedEmpNo: Int = 0           // AssignedToEmpNo
    private var selectedBrcd: Int = 0            // Bank Code
    private var selectedZone: String = ""        // Zone

    private var isUpdateMode = false
    private var taskToUpdate: TaskModel? = null

    private var assignUserList: List<User> = emptyList()

    private var mode: String = ""




    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityAddTaskBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        binding.topAppBar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }

        apiService = ApiClient.apiService

        mode = intent.getStringExtra("mode") ?: "ASSIGN_TO_OTHERS"

        if (mode == "MY_TASK") {
            enterMyTaskMode()
        }


        // CHECK IF TASK CLICKED FROM LIST
        taskToUpdate = intent.getSerializableExtra("task") as? TaskModel
        isUpdateMode = taskToUpdate != null

        if (isUpdateMode) {
            fetchUsers()   // load user list first
        } else {
            enterInsertMode()
        }


        val empNo = Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        binding.empNo.setText(empNo.toString())

        if (!isUpdateMode) {
            fetchUsers() // only for insertion
        }

        binding.taskDate.setOnClickListener { openDatePicker() }

        binding.btnSaveTask.setOnClickListener {
            if (isUpdateMode) {
                updateTask()
            } else {
                saveTask(empNo)
            }
        }




    }

    private fun enterInsertMode() {

        isUpdateMode = false

        // hide update-only fields
        binding.dailyWrkCompDetailsLayout.visibility = View.GONE
        binding.remarkLayout.visibility = View.GONE

        // editable fields
        binding.workAllocation.isEnabled = true
        binding.taskDate.isEnabled = true

        // button text
        binding.btnSaveTask.text = "Save Task"
    }

    private fun enterUpdateMode(task: TaskModel) {

        fetchUsersForName(task.AssignedToEmpNo)

        val currentUser = assignUserList.find { it.PermissionNo == task.EmpNo }




        isUpdateMode = true

        // SHOW update-only fields
        binding.dailyWrkCompDetailsLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.remarkLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        // Prefill read-only fields
//        binding.empNo.setText(task.EmpNo.toString())
        binding.empNo.setText(currentUser?.LOGINCODE ?: task.EmpNo.toString())
        binding.userName.setText(task.AssignedToEmpNo.toString()) // or resolved name if needed
        binding.branch.setText(task.BRCD.toString())
        binding.zone.setText(task.Zone ?: "")
        binding.workAllocation.setText(task.TaskDescription ?: "")
        binding.taskDate.setText(task.TaskDate.take(10))

        // Make all 6 fields read-only
        binding.empNo.isEnabled = false
        binding.userName.isEnabled = false
        binding.branch.isEnabled = false
        binding.zone.isEnabled = false
        binding.workAllocation.isEnabled = false
        binding.taskDate.isEnabled = false

        // Change button
        binding.btnSaveTask.text = "Update Task"
    }

    private fun fetchUsersForName(permissionNo: Int) {
        apiService.getUsersWithBankDetails().enqueue(object : Callback<GetUsersResponse> {
            override fun onResponse(call: Call<GetUsersResponse>, response: Response<GetUsersResponse>) {
                val users = response.body()?.Data ?: return
                val user = users.find { it.PermissionNo == permissionNo }
                binding.userName.setText(user?.USERNAME ?: "Unknown")
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<GetUsersResponse>, t: Throwable) {}
        })
    }



    private fun updateTask() {

        val task = taskToUpdate ?: return

        val completion = binding.dailyWrkCompDetails.text.toString().trim()
        val remarks = binding.remarks.text.toString().trim()

        if (completion.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter work completion details", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        apiService.updateTask(task.TaskID, completion, remarks)
            .enqueue(object : Callback<ResponseBody> {

                override fun onResponse(call: Call<ResponseBody>, response: Response<ResponseBody>) {
                    if (response.isSuccessful) {
                        Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "Task Updated", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        finish()
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "Error: ${response.message()}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                }

                override fun onFailure(call: Call<ResponseBody>, t: Throwable) {
                    Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, t.localizedMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            })

    }

//    private fun fetchUsers() {
//
//        val assignDropdown = binding.userName as AutoCompleteTextView
//
//        apiService.getUsersWithBankDetails().enqueue(object : Callback<GetUsersResponse> {
//            override fun onResponse(call: Call<GetUsersResponse>, response: Response<GetUsersResponse>) {
//

//

//                }
//            }
//

//        })
//    }

    private fun fetchUsers() {

        apiService.getUsersWithBankDetails().enqueue(object : Callback<GetUsersResponse> {

            override fun onResponse(
                call: Call<GetUsersResponse>,
                response: Response<GetUsersResponse>
            ) {
                if (response.isSuccessful && response.body()?.Status == "Success") {

                    assignUserList = response.body()?.Data ?: emptyList()

                    // Setup dropdown (for Assign-To mode)
                    setupUserDropdown(assignUserList)

                    // 🔥 Show LOGINCODE instead of EmpNo for Assign-By-You mode
                    if (mode == "ASSIGN_TO_OTHERS" && !isUpdateMode) {
                        val empNo = Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this@AddTaskActivity, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                        val currentUser = assignUserList.find { it.PermissionNo == empNo }
                        binding.empNo.setText(currentUser?.LOGINCODE ?: empNo.toString())
                    }


                    // 🔥 If My Task mode → autofill after user list loads
                    if (mode == "MY_TASK") {
                        autoFillMyTaskUser()
                    }

                    // 🔥 VERY IMPORTANT: Load Update UI AFTER users are loaded
                    if (isUpdateMode && taskToUpdate != null) {
                        enterUpdateMode(taskToUpdate!!)
                    }
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<GetUsersResponse>, t: Throwable) {}
        })
    }

    private fun autoFillMyTaskUser() {

        val empNo = Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        val user = assignUserList.find { it.PermissionNo == empNo }

        if (user != null) {
//            binding.empNo.setText(empNo.toString())
            binding.empNo.setText(user.LOGINCODE ?: empNo.toString())
            binding.branch.setText(user.BRANCHNAME ?: "")
            binding.zone.setText(user.Zone ?: "")
        } else {
            Log.e("MY_TASK", "User not found in list for PermissionNo = $empNo")
        }
    }




    private fun setupUserDropdown(list: List<User>) {

        val assignDropdown = binding.userName

        val userNames = list.map { it.USERNAME ?: "" }

        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(
            this,
            R.layout.item_dropdown,
            userNames
        )

        assignDropdown.setAdapter(adapter)

        // WHITE DROPDOWN BACKGROUND
        assignDropdown.setDropDownBackgroundDrawable(
            ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, R.color.white)
        )

        // SHOW DROPDOWN IMMEDIATELY ON CLICK
        assignDropdown.setOnClickListener { assignDropdown.showDropDown() }
        assignDropdown.setOnTouchListener { _, _ ->
            assignDropdown.showDropDown()
            false
        }

        // REAL-TIME SEARCH
        assignDropdown.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {}
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}

            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {

                val search = s.toString().trim()

                val filtered = list.filter {
                    it.USERNAME?.contains(search, ignoreCase = true) == true
                }

                val filteredNames = filtered.map { it.USERNAME ?: "" }

                val newAdapter = ArrayAdapter(
                    this@AddTaskActivity,
                    R.layout.item_dropdown,
                    filteredNames
                )

                assignDropdown.setAdapter(newAdapter)

                // White background again
                assignDropdown.setDropDownBackgroundDrawable(
                    ContextCompat.getDrawable(this@AddTaskActivity, R.color.white)
                )

                assignDropdown.showDropDown()
            }
        })

//        // ON ITEM SELECT
//        assignDropdown.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, position, _ ->
//
//            val selectedName = assignDropdown.text.toString()
//            val user = list.find { it.USERNAME == selectedName }
//
//            user?.let {
//                selectedEmpNo = it.PermissionNo
//                selectedBrcd = it.BRCD ?: 0
//                selectedZone = it.Zone ?: ""
//
//                binding.branch.setText(user.BRANCHNAME ?: "")
//                binding.zone.setText(user.Zone ?: "")
//                binding.empNo.setText(user.LOGINCODE ?: user.PermissionNo.toString())
//
//            }
//        }


        assignDropdown.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, position, _ ->

            val selectedName = assignDropdown.text.toString()
            val user = list.find { it.USERNAME == selectedName }

            user?.let {
                selectedEmpNo = it.PermissionNo
                selectedBrcd = it.BRCD ?: 0
                selectedZone = it.Zone ?: ""

                binding.branch.setText(it.BRANCHNAME ?: "")
                binding.zone.setText(it.Zone ?: "")

                // ❌ DO NOT TOUCH EmpNo here
                // EmpNo must remain logged-in user's number
            }
        }

    }




    private fun openDatePicker() {
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()
        val datePicker = DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, year, month, day ->
                val selectedDate = Calendar.getInstance()
                selectedDate.set(year, month, day)

                val formatted = SimpleDateFormat(
                    "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'",
                    Locale.getDefault()
                ).format(selectedDate.time)

                binding.taskDate.setText(formatted)
            },
            calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        )
        datePicker.show()
    }

    private fun saveTask(empNo: Int) {
        val taskDescription = binding.workAllocation.text.toString().trim()
        val taskDate = binding.taskDate.text.toString().trim()

        // MY TASK MODE
        if (mode == "MY_TASK") {
            saveMyTask(empNo)
            return
        }

        // NORMAL TASK MODE
        if (taskDescription.isEmpty() || selectedEmpNo == 0 || taskDate.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all required fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val currentDate = SimpleDateFormat(
            "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'",
            Locale.getDefault()
        ).format(Date())

        val request = TaskInsertRequest(
            EmpNo = empNo,
            AssignedToEmpNo = selectedEmpNo,
            TaskDescription = taskDescription,
            TaskDate = taskDate,
            CompletionDescription = "",
            OtherRemarks = "",
            Stage = "1001",
            Status = "Pending",
            BRCD = selectedBrcd,
            Zone = selectedZone
        )

        val call = apiService.insertTaskNew(request)

        println("🔥 FULL API URL → " + call.request().url)
        println("🔥 REQUEST BODY → " + request)

        call.enqueue(object : Callback<String> {
            override fun onResponse(call: Call<String>, response: Response<String>) {
                if (response.isSuccessful) {
                    Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "Task Saved Successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    setResult(RESULT_OK)
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "Error: ${response.message()}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<String>, t: Throwable) {
                Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "Failed: ${t.localizedMessage}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        })
    }


    private fun enterMyTaskMode() {

        // hide user dropdown
        binding.userNameLayout.visibility = View.GONE

        // disable fields
        binding.empNo.isEnabled = false
        binding.branch.isEnabled = false
        binding.zone.isEnabled = false

        // enable only these two
        binding.workAllocation.isEnabled = true
        binding.taskDate.isEnabled = true

        // Change label only for My Task
        binding.workAllocationLayout.hint = "Work Description"

    }

    private fun saveMyTask(empNo: Int) {

        val taskDescription = binding.workAllocation.text.toString().trim()
        val taskDate = binding.taskDate.text.toString().trim()
        val zone = binding.zone.text.toString()
        val branch = binding.branch.text.toString()

        if (taskDescription.isEmpty() || taskDate.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val currentDate = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())

//        val request = MyTaskRequest(
//            EmpNo = empNo,
//            TaskDescription = taskDescription,
//            TaskDate = taskDate,
//            BRCD = 0,
//            Zone = zone,
//            Status = "Pending",
//            CreatedDate = currentDate
//        )

        val request = MyTaskRequest(
            EmpNo = empNo,
            AssignedToEmpNo = empNo,       // 🔥 SAME AS EMPLOYEE'S PERMISSION NO
            TaskDescription = taskDescription,
            TaskDate = taskDate,
            CompletionDescription = "",
            OtherRemarks = "",
            BRCD = 0,
            Zone = zone,
            Status = "Pending",
            CreatedDate = currentDate
        )


        apiService.insertMyTask(request).enqueue(object : Callback<ResponseBody> {
            override fun onResponse(call: Call<ResponseBody>, response: Response<ResponseBody>) {
                if (response.isSuccessful) {
                    Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "My Task Saved", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    setResult(RESULT_OK)        // 🔥 Add this
                    finish()
                }
            else {
                    Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, "Error: ${response.message()}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<ResponseBody>, t: Throwable) {
                Toast.makeText(this@AddTaskActivity, t.localizedMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        })
    }




}

            }

            override fun getDropDownView(position: Int, convertView: android.view.View?, parent: android.view.ViewGroup): android.view.View {
                val view = super.getDropDownView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView
                view.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.black))
                view.setBackgroundColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, android.R.color.white))

            }
        }

            override fun getDropDownView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
                val view = super.getDropDownView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView
                view.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, android.R.color.black))
                view.setBackgroundColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, android.R.color.white))
                return view
            }
        }

        binding.etIsMortgaged.setAdapter(adapters)
        binding.etIsMortgaged.setDropDownBackgroundResource(android.R.color.white)
        binding.etIsMortgaged.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, android.R.color.black))

        binding.etIsMortgaged.setOnClickListener {
            binding.etIsMortgaged.showDropDown()
        }

        binding.etIsMortgaged.setOnItemClickListener { parent, view, position, id ->
            val selected = mortgagedList[position]

            if (selected == "Yes") {
                val input = EditText(this).apply {
                    hint = "Enter mortgage details"
                    setPadding(40, 20, 40, 20)
                    setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, android.R.color.black))
                    setHintTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, android.R.color.darker_gray))

                        setColor(Color.WHITE)
                        setStroke(3, Color.BLACK)
                        cornerRadius = 0f
                    }
                }

                val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle("Enter Details")
                    .setView(input)
                    .setPositiveButton("OK") { dialogInterface, _ ->
                        val detail = input.text.toString().trim()
                        binding.etIsMortgaged.setText("Yes - $detail", false) // false to prevent triggering listeners
                        dialogInterface.dismiss()
                    }
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel") { dialogInterface, _ ->
                        binding.etIsMortgaged.setText("", false)
                        dialogInterface.dismiss()
                    }
                    .create()

                dialog.setOnShowListener {
                    dialog.window?.setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.WHITE))
                    dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE)?.setTextColor(Color.BLACK)
                    dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE)?.setTextColor(Color.BLACK)
                }

                dialog.show()
            } else {
                binding.etIsMortgaged.setText("No", false)
            }
        }


        binding.etMobileNo.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}

            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}

            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                val mobile = s.toString().trim()

                if (mobile.length == 10 && mobile.all { it.isDigit() }) {
                    binding.etMobileNo.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this@AddVisitActivity, android.R.color.black))

                    binding.tilOMobile.error = "Enter valid 10-digit mobile number"
                }
            }
        })

        binding.etRequestedAmount.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            private var currentText = ""

            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}

            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}

            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                val input = s.toString()

                if (input == currentText) return

                // Remove commas
                val plainText = input.replace(",", "")

                val amount = plainText.toIntOrNull()

                // Format as per Indian locale if valid
                if (amount != null) {
                    val formatted = formatIndianAmount(amount)
                    currentText = formatted

                    // Temporarily remove listener to avoid infinite loop
                    binding.etRequestedAmount.removeTextChangedListener(this)
                    binding.etRequestedAmount.setText(formatted)
                    binding.etRequestedAmount.setSelection(formatted.length)
                    binding.etRequestedAmount.addTextChangedListener(this)

                    // Validation
                    if (amount > 500) {
                        binding.etRequestedAmount.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this@AddVisitActivity, android.R.color.black))
                        binding.tilLoanAmount.error = null
                    } else {
                        binding.etRequestedAmount.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this@AddVisitActivity, android.R.color.holo_red_dark))
                        binding.tilLoanAmount.error = "Amount must be greater than 500"
                    }
                } else {
                    binding.tilLoanAmount.error = "Enter a valid amount"
                }
            }

            private fun formatIndianAmount(amount: Int): String {
                val formatter = java.text.NumberFormat.getInstance(java.util.Locale("en", "IN"))
                return formatter.format(amount)
            }
        })


        val incomeWatcher = object : TextWatcher {
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                calculateTotalIncome()
            }

            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
        }

        binding.etSelfIncome.addTextChangedListener(incomeWatcher)
        binding.etSpouseIncome.addTextChangedListener(incomeWatcher)
        binding.etOtherIncome.addTextChangedListener(incomeWatcher)


        val expensesWatcher = object : TextWatcher {
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                calculateNetSurplusFromExpenses()
            }

            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
        }
        binding.etMonthlyExpenses.addTextChangedListener(expensesWatcher)


        binding.profilePhoto.setOnClickListener {

        binding.etMonthlyExpenses.addTextChangedListener(getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(binding.etMonthlyExpenses))
        binding.etDepositAmount.addTextChangedListener(getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(binding.etDepositAmount))
        binding.etMonthlyRent.addTextChangedListener(getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(binding.etMonthlyRent))
        binding.etLoanAmount.addTextChangedListener(getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(binding.etLoanAmount))
        binding.etMonthlyIncome.addTextChangedListener(getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(binding.etMonthlyIncome))
        binding.etApproxCost.addTextChangedListener(getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(binding.etApproxCost))

        binding.submit.setOnClickListener {
            showLoadingDialog()
            submitStaticApplicationData()
        }




        binding.etRentFrom.setOnClickListener {
            showDatePickerDialog(binding.etRentFrom)

    }


    private fun formatIndianAmount(value: Double): String {
        return try {
            val formatter = NumberFormat.getInstance(Locale("en", "IN"))
            formatter.maximumFractionDigits = 2
            formatter.format(value)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            value.toString()
        }
    }

    private fun getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(editText: TextInputEditText): TextWatcher {
        return object : TextWatcher {
            private var current = ""

            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                val input = s.toString().replace(",", "")
                if (input == current || input.isEmpty()) return

                val number = input.toDoubleOrNull() ?: return
                current = input

                val formatted = formatIndianAmount(number)
                editText.removeTextChangedListener(this)
                editText.setText(formatted)
                editText.setSelection(formatted.length)
                editText.addTextChangedListener(this)

                calculateTotalIncome()
                calculateNetSurplusFromExpenses()
            }

            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
        }
    }



    private fun calculateTotalIncome() {
        val self = parseAmount(binding.etSelfIncome.text.toString())
        val spouse = parseAmount(binding.etSpouseIncome.text.toString())
        val other = parseAmount(binding.etOtherIncome.text.toString())

        val total = self + spouse + other
        binding.etTotalIncome.setText(formatIndianAmount(total))
    }

    private fun calculateNetSurplusFromExpenses() {
        val total = parseAmount(binding.etTotalIncome.text.toString())
        val expenses = parseAmount(binding.etMonthlyExpenses.text.toString())

        val surplus = total - expenses
        binding.etNetSurplus.setText(formatIndianAmount(surplus))
    }

    private fun parseAmount(amount: String): Double {
        return amount.replace(",", "").toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0
    }

        builder.setView(dialogBinding.root)
        builder.setCancelable(false)
        dialogBinding.tvLoading.text = "Please wait..."
        loadingDialog = builder.create()
        loadingDialog?.show()
    }

    private fun dismissLoadingDialog() {
        loadingDialog?.dismiss()
    }

    private fun encodeImageToBase64(file: File): String {
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath)
        val stream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 70, stream)
        val byteArray = stream.toByteArray()
        return Base64.encodeToString(byteArray, Base64.NO_WRAP)
    }

    private fun clearFields() {
        binding.etLat.setText("")
        binding.etLong.setText("")
        binding.etDate.setText("")
        binding.etCustomer.setText("")
        binding.etMobile.setText("")
        binding.etLoanAmount.setText("")
        binding.etDocumentType.setText("")
        binding.etDocumentNo.setText("")

        // Reset image view to default
        binding.profilePhoto.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_menu_camera)

        // Delete existing photo file
        photoFile?.let {
            if (it.exists()) it.delete()
        }

        photoFile = null
    }




    private fun showToast(message: String) {
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }



    private fun checkPermissionsAndOpenCamera() {
        val cameraPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val locationPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

        if (cameraPermission && locationPermission) {
            openCamera()
        } else {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(
                this,
                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CAMERA, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION),
                PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE
            )
        }
    }

    private fun openCamera() {
        val intent = Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE)
        try {
            photoFile = createImageFile()
            val authority = "$packageName.fileprovider"
            val photoUri: Uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, authority, photoFile!!)
            intent.putExtra(MediaStore.EXTRA_OUTPUT, photoUri)
            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            startActivityForResult(intent, CAMERA_REQUEST_CODE)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Camera Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }


    @Throws(Exception::class)
    private fun createImageFile(): File {
        val timeStamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
        val storageDir = getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES)
        return File.createTempFile("IMG_${timeStamp}_", ".jpg", storageDir)
    }

    @RequiresPermission(allOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)

        if (requestCode == CAMERA_REQUEST_CODE && resultCode == RESULT_OK && photoFile != null) {
            fetchLocationAndOverlayImage()
        }
    }

    @RequiresPermission(anyOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    private fun fetchLocationAndOverlayImage() {
        if (ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Location permission not granted", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        fusedLocationClient.lastLocation.addOnSuccessListener { location ->
            if (location != null) {
                latitude = location.latitude
                longitude = location.longitude
                fullAddress = getAddressFromLocation(latitude, longitude)

                // 🔽 Set values to fields
                val currentDate = SimpleDateFormat("dd/MM/yyyy", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
                val currentTime = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()) // ⏰ Time format

                currentDateTime = currentDate

                binding.etLat.setText(latitude.toString())
                binding.etLong.setText(longitude.toString())
                binding.etDate.setText(currentDate)
                binding.etVisitTime.setText(currentTime)

                overlayImage(photoFile!!.absolutePath)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Unable to fetch location", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

    }


    private fun getAddressFromLocation(lat: Double, lon: Double): String {
        return try {
            val geocoder = Geocoder(this, Locale.getDefault())
            val addresses = geocoder.getFromLocation(lat, lon, 1)
            if (addresses != null && addresses.isNotEmpty()) addresses[0].getAddressLine(0) else "Address not found"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            "Address not found"
        }
    }

    private fun overlayImage(imagePath: String) {
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imagePath)
        val mutableBitmap = bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, true)
        val canvas = Canvas(mutableBitmap)

        val paint = Paint().apply {
            color = Color.WHITE
            textSize = 50f
            isAntiAlias = true
            setShadowLayer(10f, 5f, 5f, Color.BLACK)
        }

        val bgPaint = Paint().apply {
            color = Color.parseColor("#88000000")
            style = Paint.Style.FILL
        }

        val lines = listOf(
            "📍 $fullAddress",
            "📅 $currentDateTime",
            "🌐 Lat: $latitude",
            "🌐 Long: $longitude"
        )

        val x = 30f
        val yStart = mutableBitmap.height - lines.size * 80f - 30f

        canvas.drawRect(0f, yStart - 40f, mutableBitmap.width.toFloat(), mutableBitmap.height.toFloat(), bgPaint)

        var y = yStart
        lines.forEach {
            canvas.drawText(it, x, y, paint)
            y += 80f
        }

        saveBitmapToGallery(mutableBitmap)

        binding.profilePhoto.setImageBitmap(mutableBitmap)
    }

    private fun saveBitmapToGallery(bitmap: Bitmap) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                val contentValues = ContentValues().apply {
                    put(MediaStore.Images.Media.DISPLAY_NAME, "IMG_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
                    put(MediaStore.Images.Media.MIME_TYPE, "image/jpeg")
                    put(MediaStore.Images.Media.RELATIVE_PATH, "${Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES}/VisitApp")
                }

                val uri = contentResolver.insert(MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, contentValues)
                uri?.let {
                    contentResolver.openOutputStream(it)?.use { out ->
                        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, out)
                    }
                }
            } else {
                val dir = File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES), "VisitApp")
                if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs()
                val file = File(dir, "IMG_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
                FileOutputStream(file).use { out ->
                    bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, out)
                }
                sendBroadcast(Intent(Intent.ACTION_MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE, Uri.fromFile(file)))
            }
            Toast.makeText(this, "Image saved with location", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Save failed: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode: Int, permissions: Array<out String>, grantResults: IntArray) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE && grantResults.all { it == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }) {
            openCamera()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Permissions are required", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }


    private fun submitStaticApplicationData() {
        val missingFields = mutableListOf<String>()

        val applicantName = binding.etCustomer.text.toString().trim()
        val mobileNumber = binding.etMobile.text.toString().trim()
        val visitDate = binding.etDate.text.toString().trim()
        val visitTime = binding.etVisitTime.text.toString().trim()
        val presentPersonName = binding.PresentPersonName.text.toString().trim()
        val residentialAddress = binding.ResidentialAddress.text.toString().trim()
        val vMobileNo = binding.etVMobileNo.text.toString().trim()

        val bankName = binding.etBankName.text.toString().trim()
        val branchName = binding.etBranchName.text.toString().trim()
        val bankAddress = binding.etBankAddress.text.toString().trim()
        val accountNumber = binding.etAccountNumber.text.toString().trim()
        val hasExistingLoan = binding.etHasExistingLoan.text.toString().trim().equals("Yes", ignoreCase = true)
        val loanBankName = binding.etLoanBankName.text.toString().trim()
        val loanPurposeType = binding.etLoanPurposeType.text.toString().trim()

        val totalFamilyMembers = binding.etTotalFamilyMembers.text.toString().trim()
        val otherMemberName = binding.etOtherMemberName.text.toString().trim()
        val stayDuration = binding.etStayDuration.text.toString().trim()
        val rentFrom = binding.etRentFrom.text.toString().trim()
        val rentTo = binding.etRentTo.text.toString().trim()
        val isMortgaged = binding.etIsMortgaged.text.toString().trim()

        val occupationPersonName = binding.etPersonName.text.toString().trim()
        val occupationTitle = binding.etOccupation.text.toString().trim()
        val occupationMobile = binding.etMobileNo.text.toString().trim()
        val agriculturalLand = binding.etAgriculturalLand.text.toString().trim()
        val otherAssets = binding.etOtherAssets.text.toString().trim()

        // Validate required fields
        if (bankName.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Bank Name")
        if (branchName.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Branch Name")
        if (bankAddress.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Bank Address")
        if (accountNumber.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Account Number")
        if (binding.etHasExistingLoan.text.toString().trim().isEmpty()) {
            missingFields.add("Has Existing Loan")
        }
        if (loanPurposeType.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Loan Purpose Type")

        if (totalFamilyMembers.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Total Family Members")
        if (binding.etSelfIncome.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Self Income")
        if (binding.etSpouseIncome.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Spouse Income")
        if (binding.etOtherIncome.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Other Income")
        if (binding.etTotalIncome.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Total Income")
        if (binding.etMonthlyExpenses.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Monthly Expenses")
        if (binding.etNetSurplus.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Net Surplus")

        if (otherMemberName.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Other Member Name")
        if (binding.etApproxCost.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Approx Cost")
        if (stayDuration.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Stay Duration")
        if (isMortgaged.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Is Mortgaged")

        if (occupationPersonName.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Occupation Person Name")
        if (occupationTitle.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Occupation Title")
        if (occupationMobile.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Occupation Mobile")
        if (binding.etMonthlyIncome.text.isNullOrBlank()) missingFields.add("Monthly Income")
        if (agriculturalLand.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Agricultural Land")
        if (otherAssets.isEmpty()) missingFields.add("Other Assets")

        if (missingFields.isNotEmpty()) {
            showToast("Please fill the following fields:\n• " + missingFields.joinToString("\n• "))
            dismissLoadingDialog()
            onComplete()
            return
        }

        val formattedDate = try {
            val inputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd/MM/yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
            val outputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault())
            val parsedDate = inputFormat.parse(visitDate)
            outputFormat.format(parsedDate!!)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            showToast("Invalid date format")
            dismissLoadingDialog()
            onComplete()
            return
        }

        val empId = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_ID, "")?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        val photoBase64 = encodeImageToBase64(photoFile!!)

        val request = ApplicationRequest(
            Applicant = Applicant(
                ApplicantID = 0,
                Name = applicantName,
                ApplicationDate = formattedDate,
                ApplicationSerialNo = "APP${formattedDate.replace("-", "")}-${System.currentTimeMillis() % 10000}",
                LoanPurposeType = loanPurposeType,
                RequestedAmount = getCleanDouble(binding.etRequestedAmount),
                EmployeeId = empId,
                MobileNo = mobileNumber
            ),
            BankDetails = BankDetails(
                BankName = bankName,
                BranchName = branchName,
                BankAddress = bankAddress,
                AccountNumber = accountNumber,
                HasExistingLoan = hasExistingLoan,
                LoanBankName = loanBankName,
                LoanAmount = getCleanDouble(binding.etLoanAmount)?.toFloat() ?: 0f
            ),
            FamilyIncome = FamilyIncome(
                TotalFamilyMembers = totalFamilyMembers.toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                SelfIncome = getCleanDouble(binding.etSelfIncome),
                SpouseIncome = getCleanDouble(binding.etSpouseIncome),
                OtherIncome = getCleanDouble(binding.etOtherIncome),
                TotalIncome = getCleanDouble(binding.etTotalIncome),
                MonthlyExpenses = getCleanDouble(binding.etMonthlyExpenses),
                NetSurplus = getCleanDouble(binding.etNetSurplus)
            ),
            HousingDetails = HousingDetails(
                OtherMemberName = otherMemberName,
                ApproxCost = getCleanDouble(binding.etApproxCost),
                StayDuration = stayDuration,
                RentFrom = rentFrom,
                RentTo = rentTo,
                DepositAmount = getCleanDouble(binding.etDepositAmount),
                MonthlyRent = getCleanDouble(binding.etMonthlyRent),
                IsMortgaged = isMortgaged
            ),
            OccupationDetails = OccupationDetails(
                PersonName = occupationPersonName,
                Occupation = occupationTitle,
                MobileNo = occupationMobile,
                MonthlyIncome = getCleanDouble(binding.etMonthlyIncome),
                AgriculturalLand = agriculturalLand,
                OtherAssets = otherAssets
            ),
            visit = visitDetails(
                VisitDate = formattedDate,
                VisitTime = visitTime,
                PresentPersonName = presentPersonName,
                ResidentialAddress = residentialAddress,
                VMobileNo = vMobileNo,
                EmployeeId = empId
            ),
            avsVisit = AvsVisit(
                emp_id = empId,
                customer_name = applicantName,
                mobile_number = mobileNumber,
                loan_account = binding.etLoanAmount.text.toString().replace(",", ""),
                visit_date = visitDate,
                location = Location(
                    latitude = binding.etLat.text.toString().trim(),
                    longitude = binding.etLong.text.toString().trim()
                ),
                document_type = binding.etDocumentType.text.toString().trim(),
                document_number = binding.etDocumentNo.text.toString().trim(),
                photo_base64 = photoBase64
            )
        )

        ApiClient.apiService.submitApplication(request).enqueue(object : Callback<ApplicationResponse> {
            override fun onResponse(call: Call<ApplicationResponse>, response: Response<ApplicationResponse>) {
                dismissLoadingDialog()
                if (response.isSuccessful && response.body() != null) {
                    showToast("Application submitted successfully")
                    clearFormFields()
                    val intent = Intent(this@AddVisitActivity, Dashboard::class.java)
                    intent.flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                    startActivity(intent)
                    finish()
                } else {
                    showToast("Submission failed. Try again.")
                }
                onComplete()
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<ApplicationResponse>, t: Throwable) {
                showToast("Application API failed: ${t.message}")
                dismissLoadingDialog()
                onComplete()
            }
        })
    }


    private fun getCleanDouble(text: TextInputEditText): Double? {
        return text.text.toString().replace(",", "").toDoubleOrNull()
    }



    private fun onComplete() {
        dismissLoadingDialog()
    }



    private fun showDatePickerDialog(targetEditText: EditText) {
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()

        val datePicker = DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, year, month, dayOfMonth ->
                val backendDate = String.format("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month + 1, dayOfMonth)  // yyyy-MM-dd (backend)
                val displayDate = String.format("%02d-%02d-%04d", dayOfMonth, month + 1, year)  // dd-MM-yyyy (user)

                targetEditText.setText(displayDate)
                targetEditText.tag = backendDate  // optional: store backend format if needed later
            },
            calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        )

        datePicker.show()
    }


    private fun clearFormFields() {

        clearFields()
        // Personal & visit details
        binding.etCustomer.text?.clear()
        binding.etMobile.text?.clear()
        binding.etLoanAmount.text?.clear()
        binding.etDocumentType.text?.clear()
        binding.etDocumentNo.text?.clear()
        binding.etDate.text?.clear()
        binding.etVisitTime.text?.clear()
        binding.PresentPersonName.text?.clear()
        binding.ResidentialAddress.text?.clear()
        binding.etVMobileNo.text?.clear()

        // Bank Details
        binding.etBankName.text?.clear()
        binding.etBranchName.text?.clear()
        binding.etBankAddress.text?.clear()
        binding.etAccountNumber.text?.clear()
        binding.etHasExistingLoan.text?.clear()
        binding.etLoanBankName.text?.clear()

        // Family Income
        binding.etTotalFamilyMembers.text?.clear()
        binding.etSelfIncome.text?.clear()
        binding.etSpouseIncome.text?.clear()
        binding.etOtherIncome.text?.clear()
        binding.etTotalIncome.text?.clear()
        binding.etMonthlyExpenses.text?.clear()
        binding.etNetSurplus.text?.clear()

        // Housing Details
        binding.etOtherMemberName.text?.clear()
        binding.etApproxCost.text?.clear()
        binding.etStayDuration.text?.clear()
        binding.etRentFrom.text?.clear()
        binding.etRentTo.text?.clear()
        binding.etDepositAmount.text?.clear()
        binding.etMonthlyRent.text?.clear()
        binding.etIsMortgaged.text?.clear()

        // Occupation
        binding.etPersonName.text?.clear()
        binding.etOccupation.text?.clear()
        binding.etMobileNo.text?.clear()
        binding.etMonthlyIncome.text?.clear()
        binding.etAgriculturalLand.text?.clear()
        binding.etOtherAssets.text?.clear()
    }


}

package com.avs.visitapp

import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

object ApiClient {
//vashal junnar
//    private const val BASE_URL = "http://43.239.110.100:80/Trackme_payroll/"

    private const val BASE_URL = "https://dspcbvisit.avsinsotech.com:443/"
    private val loggingInterceptor = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
        level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
    }


    private val okHttpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .addInterceptor(loggingInterceptor)
        .connectTimeout(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS) // Time to establish connection
        .readTimeout(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)    // Time to wait for data after connection
        .writeTimeout(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)   // Time to send data
        .build()

    private val retrofit: Retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
        .baseUrl(BASE_URL)
        .client(okHttpClient)
        .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
        .build()

    val apiService: ApiService = retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}

    private val monthYearFormat = SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy", Locale.getDefault())

    private var isCheckIn = true
    private val allowedDistanceMeters = 1000f // (GPS logic skipped for now)

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = AttendanceActivityBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        fusedLocationClient = LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(this)

        val staffId = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_ID, "").toString()

        fetchLatestAttendance()

        binding.textInTime.text = "--"
        binding.textOutTime.text = "--"

        binding.toolbarBack.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, Dashboard::class.java)
            startActivity(intent)
            finish()
        }

        binding.checkIN.setOnClickListener {
            isCheckIn = true
            checkPermissionsAndOpenCamera()
        }

        binding.checkOut.setOnClickListener {
            if (binding.textInTime.text.isNullOrBlank() || binding.textInTime.text == "--") {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please Check-In before Check-Out", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            } else {
                isCheckIn = false
                checkPermissionsAndOpenCamera()
            }
        }

        // 🔹 Disable all calendar date selections permanently
        binding.calendarView.selectionMode =
            com.prolificinteractive.materialcalendarview.MaterialCalendarView.SELECTION_MODE_NONE
        binding.calendarView.setOnDateChangedListener { _, _, _ -> /* Do nothing */ }

        val initialDate = binding.calendarView.currentDate.date
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()
        calendar.time = initialDate
        binding.textMonthYear.text = monthYearFormat.format(initialDate)
        fetchAndShowMonthlyAttendance(calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR), calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1)

        binding.calendarView.setOnMonthChangedListener { _, date ->
            binding.textMonthYear.text = monthYearFormat.format(date.date)
            val cal = Calendar.getInstance()
            cal.time = date.date
            fetchAndShowMonthlyAttendance(cal.get(Calendar.YEAR), cal.get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1)
        }

        // 🔹 Hardcode and save office coordinates once
        val officeLat = 19.1107254
        val officeLong = 73.0153968



        Constant.saveSharedPreferenceValues(this, Constant.SHARE_OFFICE_LATITUDE, officeLat.toString())
        Constant.saveSharedPreferenceValues(this, Constant.SHARE_OFFICE_LONGITUDE, officeLong.toString())

        Log.d("OfficeLocation", "Office coordinates saved → Lat=$officeLat, Long=$officeLong")
    }


    // ---------------- CAMERA PERMISSIONS ----------------
    private fun checkPermissionsAndOpenCamera() {
        val cameraPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val locationPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

        if (cameraPermission && locationPermission) {
            openCamera()
        } else {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(
                this,
                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CAMERA, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION),
                REQUEST_PERMISSION
            )
        }
    }

    private fun openCamera() {
        val intent = Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE)
        try {
            photoFile = createImageFile()
            val authority = "$packageName.fileprovider"
            val photoUri: Uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, authority, photoFile!!)
            intent.putExtra(MediaStore.EXTRA_OUTPUT, photoUri)
            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            startActivityForResult(intent, if (isCheckIn) REQUEST_IMAGE_CHECK_IN else REQUEST_IMAGE_CHECK_OUT)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Camera Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    private fun createImageFile(): File {
        val timeStamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
        val storageDir = getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES)
        return File.createTempFile("IMG_${timeStamp}_", ".jpg", storageDir)
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode: Int, permissions: Array<out String>, grantResults: IntArray) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == REQUEST_PERMISSION) {
            if (grantResults.all { it == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }) {
                openCamera()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Camera/Location permission denied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------------- CAMERA RESULT ----------------
//    @RequiresPermission(allOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)

        if (resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK && photoFile != null) {
            val currentTime = timeFormat.format(Date()).uppercase(Locale.getDefault())
            val empCode = Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD).toString()

            // Save selfie temporarily
            Constant.saveSharedPreferenceValues(
                this,
                if (isCheckIn) Constant.SHARE_EMP_SELFIE_IN else Constant.SHARE_EMP_SELFIE_OUT,
                photoFile!!.absolutePath
            )

            // 🔹 Fetch GPS first, then check distance
            fetchCurrentLocation { success ->
                if (success) {
                    if (isWithinOfficeArea()) {
                        Log.d("AttendanceDebug", "✅ Within office area. Proceeding with attendance.")
                        if (isCheckIn) markAttendance(true) else markAttendance(false)
                    } else {
                        Log.d("AttendanceDebug", "❌ Outside office area. Attendance blocked.")
                        Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            "You must be inside the office area (≤ 50 m) to mark attendance",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show()
                    }
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Unable to fetch GPS location", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }
