    private fun setupBranchDropdown() {
        setupDropdowns()
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val response = ApiClient.apiService.getAllBanks()
                if (response.isSuccessful) {
                    val banks = response.body() ?: emptyList()

                    // Extract only names for dropdown
                    val branchNames = banks.mapNotNull { it.MIDNAME }

                    setupDropdown(binding.branchName, branchNames)

                    // On branch select
                    binding.branchName.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, _, _ ->
                        val selectedName = binding.branchName.text.toString().trim()

                        // Find matching bank by name
                        val selectedBank = banks.find { it.MIDNAME?.trim() == selectedName }

                        if (selectedBank != null) {
                            val selectedCode = selectedBank.BRCD?.toString() ?: "0"

                            Log.d(
                                "BranchSelection",
                                "Selected: $selectedName, Code: $selectedCode"
                            )

                            // Show branch code automatically
                            binding.branchCode.setText(selectedCode, false)

                            // Fetch loan follow-ups
                            selectedBank.BRCD?.let { brcd ->
                                fetchLoanFollowUps(brcd)
                            }
                        } else {
                            Log.e("BranchSelection", "No matching bank found for name: $selectedName")
                        }
                    }

                } else {
                    Log.e("BranchAPI", "Error response: ${response.errorBody()?.string()}")
                    Toast.makeText(
                        this@MonitoringVisitActivity,
                        "Failed to fetch branches",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                Toast.makeText(
                    this@MonitoringVisitActivity,
                    "Error: ${e.message}",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun fetchLoanFollowUps(branchCode: Int) {
        val Empid = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD, "")

        // 1. START LOADING STATE
        // Clear any old text immediately
        binding.Custname.setText(null)
        // Change the floating label (hint) to show loading status
        binding.CustnameLayout.hint = "Loading Customers..."
        // Disable the field to prevent clicks during fetch
        binding.Custname.isEnabled = false

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val customers = ApiClient.apiService.getmonitoringLoanFollowUps(branchCode, Empid)

                loanAcCustName.clear()
                customerMap.clear()

                if (customers.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    clearCustomerFields()

                    // 2. NO DATA STATE
                    binding.CustnameLayout.hint = "No Customers Found"
                    binding.Custname.isEnabled = false

                    showCustomToast("No customer assigned for selected branch")
                    return@launch
                }

//                customers.forEach { customer ->
//                    val name = customer.Name.trim()
//                    loanAcCustName.add(name)
//                    customerMap[name] = customer
//                }

                customers.forEach { customer ->
                    // OLD CODE (Causes Crash):
                    // val name = customer.Name.trim()

                    // NEW CODE (Safe):
                    // If Name is null, use empty string "" instead of crashing
                    val name = customer.Name?.trim() ?: ""

                    if (name.isNotEmpty()) { // Optional: Skip empty names if you want
                        loanAcCustName.add(name)
                        customerMap[name] = customer
                    }
                }

                // 3. SUCCESS STATE
                // Restore the original hint
                binding.CustnameLayout.hint = "Customer Name with A/c. No"
                // Enable the field for interaction
                binding.Custname.isEnabled = true

                // Attach the data to the dropdown
                setupCustNameDropdown()

            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                clearCustomerFields()

                // 4. ERROR STATE
                binding.CustnameLayout.hint = "Error Loading Data"
                binding.Custname.isEnabled = false

                showCustomToast("Error: ${e.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun setupCustNameDropdown() {
        val custName = findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.Custname)

        val uniqueCustomerNames = loanAcCustName.distinct()

        if (uniqueCustomerNames.isEmpty()) {
            clearCustomerFields()
            custName.isEnabled = false
            return
        } else {
            custName.isEnabled = true
            setupDropdown(custName, uniqueCustomerNames)
        }

        custName.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, _, _ ->
            val selectedName = custName.text.toString().trim()
            val customer = customerMap[selectedName]

            customer?.let {
                binding.LoanType.setText(it.LOANGLCODE?.toString() ?: "")


                binding.CustMobNo.setText(it.MobileNo ?: "")

                val accountNumber = try {
                    it.CUSTACCNO?.toString()?.toDoubleOrNull()?.toLong() ?: 0L
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    0L
                }
                binding.LoanAcNo.setText(accountNumber.toString())
            }
        }
    }



    private fun clearCustomerFields() {
        binding.LoanType.setText("")
        binding.CustMobNo.setText("")
        binding.LoanAcNo.setText("")
        findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.Custname).setText("")
    }

    private val customLayout = R.layout.dropdown_item

    fun setupDropdown(autoComplete: AutoCompleteTextView, data: List<String>) {
        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this, customLayout, data)
        autoComplete.setAdapter(adapter)

        // Show all items on first click
        autoComplete.setOnClickListener {
            if (!autoComplete.isPopupShowing) {
                autoComplete.showDropDown()
            }
        }

        // Filter as user types
        autoComplete.threshold = 1
        autoComplete.isFocusable = true
        autoComplete.isFocusableInTouchMode = true
    }

    private fun setupDropdowns() {
        val customLayout = R.layout.dropdown_item

        // Helper function to setup AutoCompleteTextView
        fun setupDropdown(autoComplete: AutoCompleteTextView, data: List<String>) {
            val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this, customLayout, data)
            autoComplete.setAdapter(adapter)

            // Show all items on first click
            autoComplete.setOnClickListener {
                if (!autoComplete.isPopupShowing) {
                    autoComplete.showDropDown() // show all initially
                }
            }

            // Show dropdown as user types (filters automatically)
            autoComplete.threshold = 1

            // Ensure keyboard opens
            autoComplete.isFocusable = true
            autoComplete.isFocusableInTouchMode = true
        }

        // Loan Category
        val loanCategory = findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.LoanCategory)
        setupDropdown(loanCategory, loanCategoryOptions)


    }


    private fun checkPermissionsAndOpenCamera() {
        val cameraPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val fineLocationPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val coarseLocationPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

        if (cameraPermission && fineLocationPermission && coarseLocationPermission) {
            openCamera()
        } else {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(
                this,
                arrayOf(
                    Manifest.permission.CAMERA,
                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
                ),
                PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE
            )
        }
    }

    // Handle permission result
    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            val perms = permissions.zip(grantResults.toTypedArray()).toMap()
            val cameraGranted = perms[Manifest.permission.CAMERA] == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            val fineLocationGranted = perms[Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION] == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            val coarseLocationGranted = perms[Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION] == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

            if (cameraGranted && fineLocationGranted && coarseLocationGranted) {
                openCamera()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Camera and Location permissions are required", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun openCamera() {
        val intent = Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE)
        try {
            photoFile = createImageFile()
            val authority = "$packageName.fileprovider"
            val photoUri: Uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, authority, photoFile!!)
            intent.putExtra(MediaStore.EXTRA_OUTPUT, photoUri)
            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            startActivityForResult(intent, CAMERA_REQUEST_CODE)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Camera Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    private fun createImageFile(): File {
        val timeStamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
        val storageDir = getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES)
        return File.createTempFile("IMG_${timeStamp}_", ".jpg", storageDir)
    }

    @RequiresPermission(allOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)

        if (requestCode == CAMERA_REQUEST_CODE && resultCode == RESULT_OK && photoFile != null) {
            fetchLocationAndOverlayImage()
            enableFieldsAfterPhoto()
            isImageClicked = true

            val staffName = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_NAME, "")
            binding.StaffName.setText(staffName)

        }
    }

    @RequiresPermission(anyOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    private fun fetchLocationAndOverlayImage() {
        // 1. Check Permissions
        if (ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            showCustomToast("Location permission not granted")
            return
        }

        // 2. Show Loading Dialog (Fetching live location takes time)
        showLoadingDialog()

        // 3. Fetch LIVE location (High Accuracy)
        fusedLocationClient.getCurrentLocation(Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, null)
            .addOnSuccessListener { location ->
                dismissLoadingDialog() // Hide loader

                if (location != null) {
                    latitude = location.latitude
                    longitude = location.longitude
                    fullAddress = getAddressFromLocation(latitude, longitude)

                    val currentDate = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
                    val currentTime = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
                    currentDateTime = currentDate

                    binding.etLat.setText(latitude.toString())
                    binding.etLong.setText(longitude.toString())
                    binding.etDate.setText(currentDate)
                    binding.etVisitTime.setText(currentTime)
                    binding.etAddress.setText(fullAddress)

                    // Overlay text on image
                    overlayImage(photoFile!!.absolutePath)
                } else {
                    showCustomToast("Unable to fetch location. Please ensure location is enabled.")
                }
            }
            .addOnFailureListener { e ->
                dismissLoadingDialog()
                showCustomToast("Failed to get location: ${e.message}")
            }
    }


    private fun getAddressFromLocation(lat: Double, lon: Double): String {
        return try {
            val geocoder = Geocoder(this, Locale.getDefault())
            val addresses = geocoder.getFromLocation(lat, lon, 1)
            if (!addresses.isNullOrEmpty()) addresses[0].getAddressLine(0) else "Address not found"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            "Address not found"
        }
    }

    private fun overlayImage(imagePath: String) {
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imagePath)
        val mutableBitmap = bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, true)
        val canvas = Canvas(mutableBitmap)

        val paint = Paint().apply {
            color = Color.WHITE
            textSize = 50f
            isAntiAlias = true
            setShadowLayer(10f, 5f, 5f, Color.BLACK)
        }

        val bgPaint = Paint().apply {
            color = Color.parseColor("#88000000")
            style = Paint.Style.FILL
        }

        val lines = listOf(
            "桃 $fullAddress",
            "套 $currentDateTime",
            "倹 Lat: $latitude",
            "倹 Long: $longitude"
        )

        val x = 30f
        val yStart = mutableBitmap.height - lines.size * 80f - 30f

        canvas.drawRect(0f, yStart - 40f, mutableBitmap.width.toFloat(), mutableBitmap.height.toFloat(), bgPaint)

        var y = yStart
        lines.forEach {
            canvas.drawText(it, x, y, paint)
            y += 80f
        }

//        saveBitmapToGallery(mutableBitmap)
        binding.profilePhoto.setImageBitmap(mutableBitmap)
    }



    private fun enableFieldsAfterPhoto() {
        binding.branchName.isEnabled = true
        binding.Custname.isEnabled = true
        binding.LoanAcNo.isEnabled = true
        binding.LoanType.isEnabled = true
        binding.CustMobNo.isEnabled = true
        binding.LoanCategory.isEnabled = true
        binding.LoanAmount.isEnabled = true
        binding.LoanDisbDate.isEnabled = true
        binding.EndUseFunds.isEnabled = true
        binding.OtherRemarks.isEnabled = true // Added enable for new field
    }

    private fun openDatePicker() {
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()
        val year = calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR)
        val month = calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH)
        val day = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)

        val datePicker = DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, selectedYear, selectedMonth, selectedDayOfMonth ->
                // Format date and set to EditText
                val selectedDate = String.format(
                    "%02d-%02d-%04d",
                    selectedDayOfMonth,
                    selectedMonth + 1,
                    selectedYear
                )
                binding.LoanDisbDate.setText(selectedDate)
            },
            year,
            month,
            day
        )

        // Prevent future dates
        datePicker.datePicker.maxDate = calendar.timeInMillis

        datePicker.show()
    }


    private fun setupLoanAmountFormatting() {
        binding.LoanAmount.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            private var current = ""
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                if (s.toString() != current) {
                    binding.LoanAmount.removeTextChangedListener(this)

                    val cleanString = s.toString().replace(",", "")
                    if (cleanString.isNotEmpty()) {
                        try {
                            val parsed = cleanString.toLong()
                            // Use Indian Number Format
                            val formatter = NumberFormat.getInstance(Locale("en", "IN")) as DecimalFormat
                            formatter.applyPattern("#,##,##0")
                            val formatted = formatter.format(parsed)
                            current = formatted
                            binding.LoanAmount.setText(formatted)
                            binding.LoanAmount.setSelection(formatted.length)
                        } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
                            e.printStackTrace()
                        }
                    }

                    binding.LoanAmount.addTextChangedListener(this)
                }
            }
        })
    }

    private fun validateAndSubmit(): Boolean {
        val missingFields = getMissingFields()

        return if (missingFields.isEmpty()) {

            true
        } else {
            val message = "Please fill: ${missingFields.joinToString(", ")}"
            Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            false
        }
    }

    private fun getMissingFields(): List<String> {
        val missingFields = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (binding.etDate.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Visit Date")
            setFieldError(binding.etDateLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.etDateLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.etVisitTime.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Visit Time")
            setFieldError(binding.etVisitTimeLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.etVisitTimeLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.etLat.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Latitude")
            setFieldError(binding.etLatLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.etLatLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.etLong.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Longitude")
            setFieldError(binding.etLongLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.etLongLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.etAddress.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Address")
            setFieldError(binding.etAddressLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.etAddressLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.StaffName.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Staff Name")
            setFieldError(binding.StaffNameLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.StaffNameLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.branchName.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Branch Name")
            setFieldError(binding.branchNameLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.branchNameLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.branchCode.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Branch Code")
            setFieldError(binding.branchCodeLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.branchCodeLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.Custname.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Customer Name with A/c. No")
            setFieldError(binding.CustnameLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.CustnameLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.LoanAcNo.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Loan Account No")
            setFieldError(binding.LoanAcNoLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.LoanAcNoLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.LoanType.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Loan Type")
            setFieldError(binding.LoanTypeLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.LoanTypeLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.CustMobNo.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Customer Mobile No")
            setFieldError(binding.CustMobNoLayout, true)
        } else {
            val mobile = binding.CustMobNo.text.toString().trim()
            if (mobile.length != 10 || !mobile.all { it.isDigit() }) {
                missingFields.add("Valid 10-digit Customer Mobile No")
                setFieldError(binding.CustMobNoLayout, true)
            } else {
                setFieldError(binding.CustMobNoLayout, false)
            }
        }

        if (binding.LoanCategory.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Loan Category")
            setFieldError(binding.LoanCategoryLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.LoanCategoryLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.LoanAmount.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Loan Amount")
            setFieldError(binding.LoanAmountLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.LoanAmountLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.LoanDisbDate.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Loan Disbursed Date")
            setFieldError(binding.LoanDisbDateLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.LoanDisbDateLayout, false)
        }

        if (binding.EndUseFunds.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("End Use Funds")
            setFieldError(binding.EndUseFundsLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.EndUseFundsLayout, false)
        }

        // Added validation for Other Remarks
        if (binding.OtherRemarks.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
            missingFields.add("Other Remarks")
            setFieldError(binding.OtherRemarksLayout, true)
        } else {
            setFieldError(binding.OtherRemarksLayout, false)
        }


        return missingFields
    }


    private fun setFieldError(layout: TextInputLayout, isError: Boolean) {
        if (isError) {
            layout.boxStrokeColor = resources.getColor(R.color.red, null)
        }
        else {
            layout.boxStrokeColor = resources.getColor(R.color.colorPrimaryDark, null)
        }
    }

    private fun setupFieldWatchers() {
        // Map each EditText to its corresponding TextInputLayout
        val fieldMap = mapOf(
            binding.etDate to binding.etDateLayout,
            binding.etVisitTime to binding.etVisitTimeLayout,
            binding.etLat to binding.etLatLayout,
            binding.etLong to binding.etLongLayout,
            binding.etAddress to binding.etAddressLayout,
            binding.StaffName to binding.StaffNameLayout,
            binding.branchName to binding.branchNameLayout,
            binding.branchCode to binding.branchCodeLayout,
            binding.Custname to binding.CustnameLayout,
            binding.LoanAcNo to binding.LoanAcNoLayout,
            binding.LoanType to binding.LoanTypeLayout,
            binding.CustMobNo to binding.CustMobNoLayout,
            binding.LoanCategory to binding.LoanCategoryLayout,
            binding.LoanAmount to binding.LoanAmountLayout,
            binding.LoanDisbDate to binding.LoanDisbDateLayout,
            binding.EndUseFunds to binding.EndUseFundsLayout,
            binding.OtherRemarks to binding.OtherRemarksLayout // Added watcher for new field
        )

        // Attach TextChangedListener and touch listener to each field
        fieldMap.forEach { (editText, layout) ->
            // Reset error on text change
            editText.addTextChangedListener(SimpleTextWatcher { setFieldError(layout, false) })

            // Block interaction until image is clicked
            editText.setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
                if (event.action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN && !isImageClicked) {
                    showCustomToast("Please first click image")
                    v.clearFocus()
                    true // consume event
                } else {
                    false // allow interaction
                }
            }
        }
    }


    private fun submitMonitoringVisit() {
        showLoadingDialog() // show loader immediately

        val StaffID = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD, "")?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            // Compress image off the main thread
            val imagePart = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) { createImagePart(photoFile) }

            // Convert text fields to RequestBody
            val visitDate = createPart(convertDateForServer(binding.etDate.text?.toString() ?: ""))
            val visitTime = createPart(binding.etVisitTime.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val StaffID = createPart(StaffID.toString())
            val staffName = createPart(binding.StaffName.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val branchName = createPart(binding.branchName.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val branchCode = createPart(binding.branchCode.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val customerNameWithAccountNo = createPart(binding.Custname.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val loanAccountNo = createPart(binding.LoanAcNo.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val loanType = createPart(binding.LoanType.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val customerMobileNo = createPart(binding.CustMobNo.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val loanCategory = createPart(binding.LoanCategory.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val loanAmount = createPart(parseAmountForServer(binding.LoanAmount.text?.toString() ?: ""))
            val loanDisbursedDate = createPart(convertDateForServer(binding.LoanDisbDate.text?.toString() ?: ""))
            val endUseFundsComments = createPart(binding.EndUseFunds.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val otherRemarks = createPart(binding.OtherRemarks.text?.toString() ?: "") // Added new field
            val latitude = createPart(binding.etLat.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val longitude = createPart(binding.etLong.text?.toString() ?: "")
            val fullAddress = createPart(binding.etAddress.text?.toString() ?: "")

            // API call
            ApiClient.apiService.InsertMonitoringVisit(
                VisitDate = visitDate,
                VisitTime = visitTime,
                StaffID = StaffID,
                StaffName = staffName,
                BranchName = branchName,
                BranchCode = branchCode,
                CustomerNameWithAccountNo = customerNameWithAccountNo,
                LoanAccountNo = loanAccountNo,
                LoanType = loanType,
                CustomerMobileNo = customerMobileNo,
                LoanCategory = loanCategory,
                LoanAmount = loanAmount,
                LoanDisbursedDate = loanDisbursedDate,
                EndUseFundsComments = endUseFundsComments,
                OtherRemarks = otherRemarks, // Pass to API
                Latitude = latitude,
                Longitude = longitude,
                FullAddress = fullAddress,
                image = imagePart
            ).enqueue(object : Callback<MonitoringVisitResponse> {
                override fun onResponse(call: Call<MonitoringVisitResponse>, response: Response<MonitoringVisitResponse>) {
                    dismissLoadingDialog()
                    if (response.isSuccessful && response.body() != null) {
                        Toast.makeText(this@MonitoringVisitActivity, "Monitoring visit recorded successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        startActivity(Intent(this@MonitoringVisitActivity, VisitActivity::class.java))
                        finish()
                    } else {
                        val errorMsg = response.errorBody()?.string() ?: "Unknown API error"
                        Toast.makeText(this@MonitoringVisitActivity, "API Error: $errorMsg", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    }
                }

                override fun onFailure(call: Call<MonitoringVisitResponse>, t: Throwable) {
                    dismissLoadingDialog()
                    Toast.makeText(this@MonitoringVisitActivity, "Network Error: ${t.localizedMessage}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            })
        }
    }



    private fun createPart(value: String): RequestBody =
        RequestBody.create("text/plain".toMediaTypeOrNull(), value)

    private fun createImagePart(file: File?, partName: String = "Image"): MultipartBody.Part? {
        val compressedFile = file?.let { compressImage(it, 50) } // compress to ~50KB
        return compressedFile?.let {
            val requestFile = it.asRequestBody("image/jpeg".toMediaTypeOrNull())
            Log.d("ImageCompression", "Sending Image: ${it.name}, Size: ${it.length() / 1024} KB")
            MultipartBody.Part.createFormData(partName, it.name, requestFile)
        }
    }

    private fun compressImage(file: File, maxKb: Int = 50): File? {
        return try {
            val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath)
            val outFile = File(cacheDir, "compressed_${file.name}")

            var compressQuality = 100
            var streamLength: Int

            do {
                val stream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
                bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, compressQuality, stream)
                streamLength = stream.toByteArray().size / 1024
                compressQuality -= 5
                stream.close()
            } while (streamLength > maxKb && compressQuality > 5)

            val fos = FileOutputStream(outFile)
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, compressQuality, fos)
            fos.flush()
            fos.close()

            Log.d("ImageCompression", "Compressed Image: ${outFile.name}, Size: ${outFile.length() / 1024} KB")
            outFile
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            null
        }
    }

    private fun convertDateForServer(displayDate: String): String = try {
        val displayFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
        val serverFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault())
        val date: Date = displayFormat.parse(displayDate)!!
        serverFormat.format(date)
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        ""
    }

    private fun parseAmountForServer(amountText: String?): String = try {
        val cleaned = amountText?.replace(",", "") ?: "0"
        String.format("%.2f", cleaned.toDouble())
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        "0.00"
    }

    private fun showLoadingDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogLoadingBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        val builder = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
        builder.setView(dialogBinding.root)
        builder.setCancelable(false)
        dialogBinding.tvLoading.text = "Please wait..."
        loadingDialog = builder.create()
        loadingDialog?.show()
    }

    private fun dismissLoadingDialog() {
        loadingDialog?.dismiss()
    }

}

File: app/src/main/java/com/avs/visitapp/okHttpClient.kt
================
package com.avs.visitapp

import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

val okHttpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
    .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS) // connect timeout
    .readTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)    // server response read timeout
    .writeTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)   // upload/write timeout
    .addInterceptor { chain ->
        val original: Request = chain.request()
        val requestBuilder = original.newBuilder()
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        val request = requestBuilder.build()
        chain.proceed(request)
    }
    .build()

File: app/src/main/java/com/avs/visitapp/SplashActivity.kt

package com.avs.visitapp

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.Log
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.SplashActivityBinding


class SplashActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: SplashActivityBinding
    private lateinit var mContext: Context

    private val splashTimeOut: Long = 3000 // 3 seconds

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = SplashActivityBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        mContext = this

        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({
            val userId = Constant.getSharedPreference(mContext, "SHARE_EMP_ID", "")

            if (userId.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                // Not logged in
                startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            } else {
                // Already logged in
                Log.d("USER_ID", userId)
                startActivity(Intent(this, Dashboard::class.java))
            }
            finish()
        }, splashTimeOut)
    }
}

================
File: app/src/main/java/com/avs/visitapp/TaskListActivity.kt

package com.avs.visitapp

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.text.Editable
import android.text.TextWatcher
import android.view.View
import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.avs.visitapp.Adapter.TaskAdapter
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.ActivityTaskListBinding
import com.avs.visitapp.model.TaskModel
import com.avs.visitapp.model.User
import retrofit2.Call
import retrofit2.Callback
import retrofit2.Response
import java.util.Collections.list

class TaskListActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTaskListBinding
    private lateinit var apiService: ApiService

    private var taskAdapter: TaskAdapter? = null
    private var userList: List<User> = emptyList()

    private var assignedByYouList: List<TaskModel> = emptyList()
    private var assignedToYouList: List<TaskModel> = emptyList()

    private var myTaskList: List<TaskModel> = emptyList()



    // Refresh after Add/Update Operation
    private val refreshLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()
    ) { result ->
        if (result.resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK) {

            // Reload data for whichever radio tab is active
            when (binding.radioGroupTaskType.checkedRadioButtonId) {
                binding.radioMyTask.id -> fetchMyTasks()
                binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> fetchAssignedByYou()
                binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> fetchAssignedToYou()
            }
        }
    }


    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTaskListBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        apiService = ApiClient.apiService

        // Setup RecyclerView
        binding.recyclerTasks.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)

        // Add Task Button
//        binding.fabAddTask.setOnClickListener {
//            val intent = Intent(this, AddTaskActivity::class.java)
//            refreshLauncher.launch(intent)
//        }


        binding.fabAddTask.setOnClickListener {

            val intent = Intent(this, AddTaskActivity::class.java)

            when (binding.radioGroupTaskType.checkedRadioButtonId) {

                binding.radioMyTask.id -> {
                    intent.putExtra("mode", "MY_TASK")
                    refreshLauncher.launch(intent)
                }

                binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> {
                    intent.putExtra("mode", "ASSIGN_TO_OTHERS")
                    refreshLauncher.launch(intent)
                }

                binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "You cannot add tasks here", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }



        binding.toolbarSearch.setOnClickListener {
            showSearchBar()
        }
        binding.toolbarBack.setOnClickListener {
            onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed()
        }


        binding.etSearchBar.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {}

            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}

            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {
                applySearchFilter(s.toString())
            }
        })


        binding.toolbarBack.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, VisitActivity::class.java)
            startActivity(intent)
            finish()
        }



        setupTaskTypeSelector()

        // FIRST: fetch users → THEN load tasks
        fetchUsersThenLoadTasks()
    }


    private fun showSearchBar() {
        binding.toolbarTitle.visibility = View.GONE
        binding.toolbarSearch.visibility = View.GONE
        binding.etSearchBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.etSearchBar.requestFocus()

        // OPEN KEYBOARD
        val imm = getSystemService(INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as InputMethodManager
        imm.showSoftInput(binding.etSearchBar, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT)
    }

    private fun hideSearchBar() {
        binding.toolbarTitle.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.toolbarSearch.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.etSearchBar.visibility = View.GONE
        binding.etSearchBar.setText("")

        applySearchFilter("")  // reset filtered list

        // HIDE KEYBOARD
        val imm = getSystemService(INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as InputMethodManager
        imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(binding.etSearchBar.windowToken, 0)
    }


    private fun applySearchFilter(query: String) {

        val search = query.trim().lowercase()
        val filteredList: List<TaskModel>
        val mode: String

        when (binding.radioGroupTaskType.checkedRadioButtonId) {

            binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> {
                mode = "ASSIGNED_BY_YOU"
                filteredList = assignedByYouList.filter { task ->
                    task.AssignedToName?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true ||
                            task.BranchName?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true ||
                            task.TaskDescription.lowercase().contains(search) ||
                            task.OtherRemarks?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true ||
                            task.CompletionDescription?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true
                }
            }

            binding.radioMyTask.id -> {
                mode = "MY_TASK"
                filteredList = myTaskList.filter { task ->
                    task.TaskDescription.lowercase().contains(search)
                            || task.OtherRemarks?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true
                }
            }

            binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> {
                mode = "ASSIGNED_TO_YOU"
                filteredList = assignedToYouList.filter { task ->
                    task.AssignedToName?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true ||
                            task.BranchName?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true ||
                            task.TaskDescription.lowercase().contains(search) ||
                            task.OtherRemarks?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true ||
                            task.CompletionDescription?.lowercase()?.contains(search) == true
                }
            }

            else -> {
                mode = "ASSIGNED_BY_YOU"
                filteredList = assignedByYouList
            }
        }

        if (filteredList.isEmpty()) showNoTaskMessage()
        else hideNoTaskMessage()

        updateRecycler(filteredList, mode)
    }



    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1️⃣ FETCH USERS FIRST
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun fetchUsersThenLoadTasks() {
        apiService.getUsersWithBankDetails().enqueue(object : Callback<GetUsersResponse> {
            override fun onResponse(
                call: Call<GetUsersResponse>,
                response: Response<GetUsersResponse>
            ) {
                if (response.isSuccessful) {
                    userList = response.body()?.Data ?: emptyList()
                } else {
                    userList = emptyList()
                }

                // After loading users, load the selected tab
                when (binding.radioGroupTaskType.checkedRadioButtonId) {
                    binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> fetchAssignedByYou()
                    binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> fetchAssignedToYou()
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<GetUsersResponse>, t: Throwable) {
                userList = emptyList()

                when (binding.radioGroupTaskType.checkedRadioButtonId) {
                    binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> fetchAssignedByYou()
                    binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> fetchAssignedToYou()
                }
            }
        })
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2️⃣ FETCH TASKS ASSIGNED BY YOU  (Current API)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun fetchAssignedByYou() {
        val staffId =
            Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        apiService.getTasks(staffId).enqueue(object : Callback<List<TaskModel>> {
            override fun onResponse(
                call: Call<List<TaskModel>>,
                response: Response<List<TaskModel>>
            ) {
                if (response.isSuccessful) {
                    val tasks = response.body() ?: emptyList()

                    // Merge username + branch
                    for (task in tasks) {
                        val user = userList.find { it.PermissionNo == task.AssignedToEmpNo }
                        task.AssignedToName = user?.USERNAME ?: "Unknown"
                        task.BranchName = user?.BRANCHNAME ?: "Unknown"
                    }

                    assignedByYouList = tasks
                    applySearchFilter(binding.etSearchBar.text.toString())


                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<List<TaskModel>>, t: Throwable) {
                Toast.makeText(this@TaskListActivity, t.localizedMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        })
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3️⃣ FETCH TASKS ASSIGNED TO YOU (API will be added later)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun fetchAssignedToYou() {

        val empNo =
            Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        apiService.getAssignedTasks(empNo).enqueue(object : Callback<List<TaskModel>> {
            override fun onResponse(
                call: Call<List<TaskModel>>,
                response: Response<List<TaskModel>>
            ) {

                if (response.isSuccessful) {

                    val list = response.body() ?: emptyList()

                    if (list.isEmpty()) {
                        showNoTaskMessage()
                        return
                    }

                    // Merge username + branch
                    for (task in list) {
                        val user = userList.find { it.PermissionNo == task.AssignedToEmpNo }
                        task.AssignedToName = user?.USERNAME ?: "Unknown"
                        task.BranchName = user?.BRANCHNAME ?: "Unknown"
                    }

                    hideNoTaskMessage()
                    assignedToYouList = list
                    applySearchFilter(binding.etSearchBar.text.toString())


                } else {
                    showNoTaskMessage()
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<List<TaskModel>>, t: Throwable) {
                showNoTaskMessage()
            }
        })
    }


    private fun showNoTaskMessage() {
        binding.recyclerTasks.visibility = View.GONE
        binding.tvNoTasks.visibility = View.VISIBLE
    }

    private fun hideNoTaskMessage() {
        binding.recyclerTasks.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.tvNoTasks.visibility = View.GONE
    }



    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // RADIO BUTTON SELECTOR
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun setupTaskTypeSelector() {
//        binding.radioGroupTaskType.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checkedId ->
//            when (checkedId) {
//                binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> fetchAssignedByYou()
//                binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> fetchAssignedToYou()
//            }
//        }

        binding.radioGroupTaskType.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checkedId ->
            when (checkedId) {
                binding.radioAssignedByYou.id -> fetchAssignedByYou()
                binding.radioMyTask.id -> fetchMyTasks()
                binding.radioAssignedToYou.id -> fetchAssignedToYou()
            }
        }

    }

    private fun fetchMyTasks() {

        val empNo =
            Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        apiService.getMyTasks(empNo).enqueue(object : Callback<List<TaskModel>> {
            override fun onResponse(
                call: Call<List<TaskModel>>,
                response: Response<List<TaskModel>>
            ) {
                if (response.isSuccessful) {

                    myTaskList = response.body() ?: emptyList()

                    val currentUser = userList.find { it.PermissionNo == empNo }

                    for (task in myTaskList) {
                        task.AssignedToName = currentUser?.USERNAME ?: "You"
                        task.BranchName = currentUser?.BRANCHNAME ?: "Unknown"
                        task.Zone = currentUser?.Zone ?: "Unknown"
                    }

                    if (myTaskList.isEmpty()) showNoTaskMessage()
                    else hideNoTaskMessage()

                    updateRecycler(myTaskList, "MY_TASK")


                } else {
                    showNoTaskMessage()
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<List<TaskModel>>, t: Throwable) {
                showNoTaskMessage()
            }
        })
    }




    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // UPDATE RECYCLER ADAPTER
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun updateRecycler(tasks: List<TaskModel>, mode: String) {

        if (taskAdapter == null) {

            taskAdapter = TaskAdapter(tasks, mode) { selectedTask ->
                openTaskInEdit(selectedTask)
            }

            binding.recyclerTasks.adapter = taskAdapter

        } else {
            taskAdapter!!.updateTasks(tasks)
        }
    }


    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // OPEN TASK IN EDIT MODE
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun openTaskInEdit(task: TaskModel) {
        val intent = Intent(this, AddTaskActivity::class.java)
        intent.putExtra("task", task)

        // 🔥 Also send user list so update mode shows LoginCode
        intent.putExtra("user_list_loaded", true)

        refreshLauncher.launch(intent)
    }





}

    private fun prefillData() {
        val v = visitData!!

        // Auto-filled (read-only)
        binding.Custname.setText(v.CustomerName)
        binding.LoanAcNo.setText(v.LoanAccNo)
        binding.CustMobNo.setText(v.CustMobileNo)
        binding.Branch.setText(v.BranchName)
        binding.OverdueAmount.setText(v.ODAmt)
        binding.Case101.setText(v.Loan101_91 ?: "")
        binding.PromiseToPay.setText(v.PromiseToPay ?: "")
        binding.VisitPlace.setText(v.VisitedPlaceName ?: "")
        binding.OtherRemarks.setText(v.OtherRemarks ?: "")

        // Editable fields only
        binding.Comments.setText(v.Comments ?: "")
        binding.PTPDate.setText(v.PTPDate ?: "")

        // Disable all non-editable fields
        binding.Custname.isEnabled = false
        binding.LoanAcNo.isEnabled = false
        binding.CustMobNo.isEnabled = false
        binding.Branch.isEnabled = false
        binding.OverdueAmount.isEnabled = false
        binding.Case101.isEnabled = false
        binding.PromiseToPay.isEnabled = false
        binding.VisitPlace.isEnabled = false
        binding.OtherRemarks.isEnabled = false
    }

    private fun setupListeners() {
        binding.PTPDate.setOnClickListener { openDatePicker() }

        binding.btnUpdate.setOnClickListener {
            submitUpdateVisitAgain()
        }
    }

    private fun openDatePicker() {
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()
        val dp = DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, year, month, day ->
                val formatted = "$year-${month + 1}-$day"
                binding.PTPDate.setText(formatted)
            },
            calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        )
        dp.show()
    }

    private fun submitUpdateVisitAgain() {



        val comments = binding.Comments.text.toString().trim()
        val ptpDate = binding.PTPDate.text.toString().trim()

        if (comments.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Add comments", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val empNo = Constant.getSharedPreferenceValue(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_CD)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        val v = visitData!!

        val request = VisitAgainUpdateRequest(
            AccountNo = v.LoanAccNo ?: "",
            LoanAccountNo = v.LoanAccNo ?: "",
            BranchCode = v.BRCD.toString(),
            StaffID = 0,
            LoanType = v.ProdctCD ?: "",
            Comments = comments,
//            PTPDate = if (ptpDate.isEmpty()) null else ptpDate,   // FIX
            PTPDate = v.PTPDate ?: "",
            Latitude = if (latitude.isEmpty()) "0" else latitude, // FIX


            Longitude = if (longitude.isEmpty()) "0" else longitude // FIX
        )

        apiService.updateVisitAgain(request).enqueue(object : Callback<ResponseBody> {
            override fun onResponse(call: Call<ResponseBody>, response: Response<ResponseBody>) {
                if (response.isSuccessful) {
                    Toast.makeText(this@VisitAgainUpdateActivity, "Visit Again Updated", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    setResult(RESULT_OK)
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this@VisitAgainUpdateActivity, "Error: ${response.code()}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }

            override fun onFailure(call: Call<ResponseBody>, t: Throwable) {
                Toast.makeText(this@VisitAgainUpdateActivity, t.localizedMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        })
    }

}

            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {
                val mobile = s?.toString()?.trim() ?: ""

                if (mobile.length != 10 || !mobile.all { it.isDigit() }) {
                    // Invalid: red outline and error message
                    delinquencymobileLayout.boxStrokeColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this@VisitApplicationActivity, R.color.red)
                    delinquencymobileLayout.error = "Enter 10 digit number"
                } else {
                    // Valid: reset to default

                    delinquencymobileLayout.error = null
                }
            }

            binding.loanEnquriyLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.MarketingVisitLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.MonitoringVisitLayout.visibility = View.GONE

            when (currentVisitType?.lowercase()) {
                "loan recovery" -> binding.loanRecoveryLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                "loan enquiry" -> binding.loanEnquriyLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                "delinquency visit" -> binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                "marketing visit" -> binding.MarketingVisitLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                "monitoring visit" -> binding.MonitoringVisitLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                else -> Log.d(TAG, "Unknown visit type: $currentVisitType")

        binding.submit.setOnClickListener {
            Log.d(TAG, "Submit clicked. Current visit type: $currentVisitType")

            if (currentVisitType.isNullOrBlank()) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please select a visit type", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                Log.d(TAG, "No visit type selected")
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            when (currentVisitType!!.lowercase()) {
                "loan recovery" -> {
                    Log.d(TAG, "Validating Loan Recovery fields")
                    if (validateLoanRecoveryFields()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Application submitted successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        Log.d(TAG, "Loan Recovery submission successful")
                    }
                }
                "loan enquiry" -> {
                    Log.d(TAG, "Validating Loan Enquiry fields")
                    if (validateLoanEnquiryFields()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Application submitted successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        Log.d(TAG, "Loan Enquiry submission successful")
                    }
                }
                "delinquency visit" -> {
                    Log.d(TAG, "Validating Delinquency Visit fields")
                    if (validateDelinquencyVisitFields()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Application submitted successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        Log.d(TAG, "Delinquency Visit submission successful")
                    }
                }
                "marketing visit" -> {
                    Log.d(TAG, "Validating Marketing Visit fields")
                    if (validateMarketingVisitFields()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Application submitted successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        Log.d(TAG, "Marketing Visit submission successful")
                    }
                }
                "monitoring visit" -> {
                    Log.d(TAG, "Validating Monitoring Visit fields")
                    if (validateMonitoringVisitFields()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Application submitted successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        Log.d(TAG, "Monitoring Visit submission successful")
                    }
                }
                else -> {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Please select a valid visit type", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    Log.d(TAG, "Unknown or invalid visit type: $currentVisitType")
                }
            }
        }

    private fun validateDelinquencyVisitFields(): Boolean {
        val custnameLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.CustnameLayout)
        val custnameEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.Custname)

        val loanAcNoLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.LoanAcNoLayout)
        val loanAcNoEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.LoanAcNo)

        val loanTypeLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.LoanTypeLayout)
        val loanTypeEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.LoanType)

        val custMobLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.CustMobNoLayout)
        val custMobEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.CustMobNo)

        val loanCategoryLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.LoanCategoryLayout)
        val loanCategoryEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.LoanCategory)

        val caseLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.CaseLayout)
        val caseEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.Case)

        val overdueAmountLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.OverdueAmountLayout)
        val overdueAmountEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.OverdueAmount)

        val promisetoPayLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.PromisetoPayLayout)
        val promisetoPayEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.PromisetoPay)

        val ptpDateLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.PTPDateLayout)
        val ptpDateEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.PTPDate)

        val visitPlaceLayout = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(R.id.VisitPlaceLayout)
        val visitPlaceEdit = binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.VisitPlace)

        // Customer Name
        val custname = custnameEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (custname.isEmpty()) {
            custnameLayout.error = "Enter Customer Name"
            custnameLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter Customer Name", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            custnameLayout.error = null
        }

        // Loan Account Number
        val loanAcNo = loanAcNoEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (loanAcNo.isEmpty()) {
            loanAcNoLayout.error = "Enter Loan Account Number"
            loanAcNoLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter Loan Account Number", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            loanAcNoLayout.error = null
        }

        // Loan Type
        val loanType = loanTypeEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (loanType.isEmpty()) {
            loanTypeLayout.error = "Select Loan Type"
            loanTypeLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Select Loan Type", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            loanTypeLayout.error = null
        }

        // Customer Mobile Number
        val custMob = custMobEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (custMob.isEmpty()) {
            custMobLayout.error = "Enter Customer Mobile Number"
            custMobLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter Customer Mobile Number", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else if (custMob.length != 10 || !custMob.all { it.isDigit() }) {
            custMobLayout.error = "Enter valid 10-digit Mobile Number"
            custMobLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter valid 10-digit Mobile Number", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            custMobLayout.error = null
        }

        // Loan Category
        val loanCategory = loanCategoryEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (loanCategory.isEmpty()) {
            loanCategoryLayout.error = "Select Loan Category"
            loanCategoryLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Select Loan Category", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            loanCategoryLayout.error = null
        }

        // Case
        val caseVal = caseEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (caseVal.isEmpty()) {
            caseLayout.error = "Enter Case"
            caseLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter Case", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            caseLayout.error = null
        }

        // Overdue Amount
        val overdueAmount = overdueAmountEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()

        if (overdueAmount.isEmpty()) {
            overdueAmountLayout.error = "Enter Overdue Amount"
            overdueAmountLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter Overdue Amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            try {
                // Remove commas from user input
                val cleanAmount = overdueAmount.replace(",", "")
                val amount = cleanAmount.toDouble()

                if (amount <= 0) {
                    overdueAmountLayout.error = "Enter valid amount greater than 0"
                    overdueAmountLayout.requestFocus()
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Enter valid amount greater than 0", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return false
                }

                // Clear error
                overdueAmountLayout.error = null

                // Optional: if you want to display the formatted plain number
                overdueAmountEdit.setText(amount.toString()) // converts "1,000" -> "1000"

            } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
                overdueAmountLayout.error = "Enter valid number"
                overdueAmountLayout.requestFocus()
                Toast.makeText(this, "Enter valid number for Overdue Amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return false
            }
        }


        // Promise to Pay
        val promisetoPay = promisetoPayEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (promisetoPay.isEmpty()) {
            promisetoPayLayout.error = "Select Promise to Pay"
            promisetoPayLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Select Promise to Pay", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            promisetoPayLayout.error = null
        }

        // PTP Date
        val ptpDate = ptpDateEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (ptpDate.isEmpty()) {
            ptpDateLayout.error = "Select PTP Date"
            ptpDateLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Select PTP Date", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            ptpDateLayout.error = null
        }

        // Visit Place
        val visitPlace = visitPlaceEdit.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (visitPlace.isEmpty()) {
            visitPlaceLayout.error = "Enter Visit Place"
            visitPlaceLayout.requestFocus()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter Visit Place", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return false
        } else {
            visitPlaceLayout.error = null
        }

        // All validations passed
        return true
    }

        } else {
            try {
                // Remove commas
                val cleanAmountStr = loanAmountStr.replace(",", "")
                val amount = cleanAmountStr.toDouble()

                if (amount <= 0) {
                    loanAmountLayout.error = "Enter valid Loan Amount"

        } else {
            loanDisbDateLayout.error = null
        }

        // All validations passed
        return true
    }


    private fun setupBranchDropdown() {

    }

        }
    }

    private fun fetchVisitTypes() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val response = ApiClient.apiService.getLoanVisitTypes()
                if (response.isSuccessful && response.body()?.status == "success") {
                    val visitTypeList = response.body()?.data?.map { it.visit_type_name } ?: emptyList()
                    setupDropdownAdapter(visitTypeList) // 🔹 call here
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this@VisitApplicationActivity, "Failed to load visit types", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                Toast.makeText(this@VisitApplicationActivity, "Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }


    private fun setupDropdownAdapter(visitTypes: List<String>) {
        val visitAdapter = ArrayAdapter(this, R.layout.dropdown_item, visitTypes)
        binding.VisitType.setAdapter(visitAdapter)
        binding.VisitType.threshold = 0

        // Show dropdown when user clicks
        binding.VisitType.setOnClickListener {
            binding.VisitType.showDropDown()
        }

        binding.VisitType.setOnItemClickListener { parent, _, position, _ ->
            val selectedType = parent.getItemAtPosition(position) as String

            // 1️⃣ Store the selected value for Submit
            currentVisitType = selectedType

            // 2️⃣ Show the selected value in your separate TextView
            binding.VisitTypeName.text = selectedType

            Log.d(TAG, "Selected visit type: $currentVisitType")

            // Clear all previous visit type fields before showing the new layout
            clearAllVisitTypeFields()

            // Hide all conditional layouts first
            binding.loanRecoveryLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.loanEnquriyLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.MarketingVisitLayout.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.MonitoringVisitLayout.visibility = View.GONE

            // Show layout based on selected visit type
            when (selectedType) {
//                "Loan Recovery" -> {
//                    binding.loanRecoveryLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
//                    setupLoanRecoveryDropdowns()
//                }
//                "Loan Enquiry" -> {
//                    binding.loanEnquriyLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
//                    setupLoanEnquiryDropdowns()
//                }
                "Delinquency Visit" -> {
                    binding.delinquencyvisitLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                    setupDelinquencyVisitDropdowns()
                }
                "Marketing Visit" -> {
                    binding.MarketingVisitLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                    setupMarketingVisitDropdowns()
                }
                "Monitoring Visit" -> {
                    binding.MonitoringVisitLayout.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                    setupMonitoringVisitDropdowns()
                }
            }
        }
    }


    private fun clearAllVisitTypeFields() {
        fun clearViews(view: View) {
            when (view) {
                is ViewGroup -> {
                    for (i in 0 until view.childCount) {
                        clearViews(view.getChildAt(i))
                    }
                }
                is TextInputEditText -> {
                    view.text?.clear()
                    // Also clear the error/red border on parent TextInputLayout
                    val parentLayout = view.parent.parent
                    if (parentLayout is TextInputLayout) {
                        parentLayout.error = null
                        parentLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                    }
                }
                is AutoCompleteTextView -> {
                    view.setText("", false)
                    // Clear red border if inside TextInputLayout
                    val parentLayout = view.parent.parent
                    if (parentLayout is TextInputLayout) {
                        parentLayout.error = null
                        parentLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                    }
                }
                // Add other input types if needed
            }
        }

        // Call for all visit type layouts
        clearViews(binding.loanRecoveryLayout)
        clearViews(binding.loanEnquriyLayout)
        clearViews(binding.delinquencyvisitLayout)
        clearViews(binding.MarketingVisitLayout)
        clearViews(binding.MonitoringVisitLayout)
    }

    private fun submitLoanRecoveryVisit() {
        val layout = binding.loanRecoveryLayout

        // 1️⃣ Validate all fields first
        if (!validateLoanRecoveryFields()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all required fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return  // Stop API call if validation fails
        }

        // 2️⃣ Show loading dialog after validation passes
        showLoadingDialog()

        val staffId = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_ID, "")?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0

        fun convertDateForServer(displayDate: String): String {
            return try {
                val displayFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
                val serverFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault())
                val date: Date = displayFormat.parse(displayDate)!!
                serverFormat.format(date)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                ""
            }
        }

        fun parseAmountForServer(amountText: String?): Double {
            return try {
                val cleaned = amountText?.replace(",", "") ?: "0"
                String.format("%.2f", cleaned.toDouble()).toDouble()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                0.0
            }
        }

        val photoBase64 = photoFile?.let { encodeImageToBase64(it) } ?: ""

        val request = LoanVisitRequest(
            Staff_id = staffId,
            Image = photoBase64,
            CustomerNameAccount = layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.Custname)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            LoanAccountNo = layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.AcNo)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            LoanType = layout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.LoanType)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            CustomerMobileNo = layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.CustMobNo)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            LoanCategory = layout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.LoanCategory)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            LoanDisbursedDate = convertDateForServer(layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.LoanDisbDate)?.text?.toString() ?: ""),
            Case_101_91 = layout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.Case)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            OverdueAmount = parseAmountForServer(layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.OverdueAmount)?.text?.toString()),
            Comments = layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.Comments)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            PromiseToPay = layout.findViewById<AutoCompleteTextView>(R.id.PromisetoPay)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            PtpDate = convertDateForServer(layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.PTPDate)?.text?.toString() ?: ""),
            VisitTime = binding.etVisitTime.text?.toString() ?: "",
            OtherRemarks = layout.findViewById<TextInputEditText>(R.id.OtherRemarks)?.text?.toString() ?: "",
            Latitude = binding.etLat.text?.toString() ?: "",
            Longitude = binding.etLong.text?.toString() ?: "",
            BankName = binding.branchName.text?.toString() ?: "",
            BranchName = binding.branchCode.text?.toString() ?: "",
            VisitDate = convertDateForServer(binding.etDate.text?.toString() ?: "")
        )

        // 3️⃣ API call
        ApiClient.apiService.insertLoanVisit(request)
            .enqueue(object : Callback<LoanVisitResponse> {
                override fun onResponse(call: Call<LoanVisitResponse>, response: Response<LoanVisitResponse>) {
                    dismissLoadingDialog()
                    if (response.isSuccessful && response.body() != null) {
                        Toast.makeText(this@VisitApplicationActivity, "Success: ${response.body()!!.Message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        startActivity(Intent(this@VisitApplicationActivity, Dashboard::class.java))
                        finish()
                    } else {
                        val errorMsg = response.errorBody()?.string() ?: "Unknown API error"
                        Toast.makeText(this@VisitApplicationActivity, "API Error: $errorMsg", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    }
                }

                override fun onFailure(call: Call<LoanVisitResponse>, t: Throwable) {
                    dismissLoadingDialog()
                    Toast.makeText(this@VisitApplicationActivity, "Network Error: ${t.localizedMessage}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            })
    }

    private fun showLoadingDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogLoadingBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        val builder = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
        builder.setView(dialogBinding.root)
        builder.setCancelable(false)
        dialogBinding.tvLoading.text = "Please wait..."
        loadingDialog = builder.create()
        loadingDialog?.show()
    }

    private fun dismissLoadingDialog() {
        loadingDialog?.dismiss()
    }

    private fun encodeImageToBase64(file: File): String {
        // Decode bitmap
        val originalBitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath)

        // Resize the image to a smaller width while keeping aspect ratio
        val maxWidth = 800
        val scale = maxWidth.toFloat() / originalBitmap.width
        val newHeight = (originalBitmap.height * scale).toInt()
        val resizedBitmap = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(originalBitmap, maxWidth, newHeight, true)

        // Compress bitmap to JPEG with lower quality (50%)
        val stream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        resizedBitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 50, stream)
        val byteArray = stream.toByteArray()

        // Optional: log the size for debugging
        Log.d("ImageCompression", "Compressed image size: ${byteArray.size / 1024} KB")

        return Base64.encodeToString(byteArray, Base64.NO_WRAP)
    }
