    private fun validateLoanRecoveryFields(): Boolean {
        val loanRecoveryLayout = binding.loanRecoveryLayout
        var isValid = true

        // Helper to validate EditText fields
        fun checkField(
            textInputLayout: TextInputLayout,
            field: TextInputEditText,
            message: String,
            extraValidation: ((TextInputLayout, String) -> Unit)? = null
        ) {
            val text = field.text?.toString().orEmpty()

            if (text.isBlank()) {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = true
                textInputLayout.error = message
                isValid = false
            } else {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
                extraValidation?.invoke(textInputLayout, text)
            }

            // Clear error when user types
            field.addTextChangedListener {
                if (!it.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                    textInputLayout.error = null
                }
            }
        }

        // Helper to validate dropdowns (AutoCompleteTextView)
        fun checkDropdown(
            textInputLayout: TextInputLayout,
            field: AutoCompleteTextView,
            message: String
        ) {
            val text = field.text?.toString().orEmpty()

            if (text.isBlank()) {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = true
                textInputLayout.error = message
                isValid = false
            } else {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
            }

            // Clear error when an item is selected
            field.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, _, _ ->
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
            }
        }

        // ----- Validation calls for all fields -----
        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CustnameLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Custname),
            "Customer name is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CustBranchLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CustBranch),
            "Branch is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.AcNoLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.AcNo),
            "Account number is required"
        )

        checkDropdown(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanTypeLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanType),
            "Loan type is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CustMobNoLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CustMobNo),
            "Mobile number is required"
        ) { layout, text ->
            if (!text.matches(Regex("\\d{10}"))) {
                layout.isErrorEnabled = true
                layout.error = "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number"
                isValid = false
            }
        }

        checkDropdown(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanCategoryLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanCategory),
            "Loan category is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanDisbDateLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanDisbDate),
            "Disbursed date is required"
        )

        checkDropdown(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CaseLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Case),
            "Case is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.OverdueAmountLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.OverdueAmount),
            "Overdue amount is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CommentsLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Comments),
            "Comments are required"
        )

        checkDropdown(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.PromisetoPayLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.PromisetoPay),
            "Promise to pay is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.PTPDateLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.PTPDate),
            "PTP date is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.OtherRemarksLayout),
            loanRecoveryLayout.findViewById(R.id.OtherRemarks),
            "Other remarks are required"
        )

        return isValid
    }

    private fun validateLoanEnquiryFields(): Boolean {
        val loanEnquiryLayout = binding.loanEnquriyLayout
        var isValid = true

        fun checkField(textInputLayout: TextInputLayout, field: TextInputEditText, message: String) {
            // Remove error on text change
            field.addTextChangedListener {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
            }

            if (field.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = true
                textInputLayout.error = message
                isValid = false
            } else {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
            }
        }

        fun checkDropdown(textInputLayout: TextInputLayout, field: AutoCompleteTextView, message: String) {
            // Remove error on item select
            field.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, _, _ ->
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
            }

            if (field.text.isNullOrBlank()) {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = true
                textInputLayout.error = message
                isValid = false
            } else {
                textInputLayout.isErrorEnabled = false
                textInputLayout.error = null
            }
        }

        checkDropdown(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanTypeLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.LoanType),
            "Loan type is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.AmountLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Amount),
            "Amount is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.CibilScoreLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.cibilscore),
            "Cibil score is required"
        )

        checkDropdown(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.EligibilityLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Eligibility),
            "Eligibility is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.salaryLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.salaryBussiness),
            "Salary/Business is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.PeriodLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Period),
            "Period is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.RateLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.Rate),
            "Rate is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.InstallAmountLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.InstallAmount),
            "Installment amount is required"
        )

        checkField(
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.ExpireryDateLayout),
            loanEnquiryLayout.findViewById(R.id.ExpireryDate),
            "Expiry date is required"
        )

        return isValid
    }


    private fun clearLoanRecoveryErrors() {
        val layout = binding.loanRecoveryLayout
        val textInputLayouts = listOf(
            R.id.CustnameLayout, R.id.CustBranchLayout, R.id.AcNoLayout,
            R.id.LoanTypeLayout, R.id.CustMobNoLayout, R.id.LoanCategoryLayout,
            R.id.LoanDisbDateLayout, R.id.CaseLayout, R.id.OverdueAmountLayout,
            R.id.CommentsLayout, R.id.PromisetoPayLayout, R.id.PTPDateLayout,
            R.id.OtherRemarksLayout
        )
        textInputLayouts.forEach { id ->
            val til = layout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(id)
            til.isErrorEnabled = false
            til.error = null
        }
    }

    private fun clearLoanEnquiryErrors() {
        val layout = binding.loanEnquriyLayout
        val textInputLayouts = listOf(
            R.id.LoanTypeLayout, R.id.AmountLayout, R.id.CibilScoreLayout,
            R.id.EligibilityLayout, R.id.salaryLayout, R.id.PeriodLayout,
            R.id.RateLayout, R.id.InstallAmountLayout, R.id.ExpireryDateLayout
        )
        textInputLayouts.forEach { id ->
            val til = layout.findViewById<TextInputLayout>(id)
            til.isErrorEnabled = false
            til.error = null
        }
    }



    private fun formatIndianAmount(value: Double): String {
        return try {
            val formatter = NumberFormat.getInstance(Locale("en", "IN"))
            formatter.maximumFractionDigits = 2
            formatter.format(value)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            value.toString()
        }
    }

    private fun getIndianCurrencyTextWatcher(editText: TextInputEditText): TextWatcher {
        return object : TextWatcher {
            private var current = ""

            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                val input = s.toString().replace(",", "")
                if (input == current || input.isEmpty()) return

                val number = input.toDoubleOrNull() ?: return
                current = input

                val formatted = formatIndianAmount(number)
                editText.removeTextChangedListener(this)
                editText.setText(formatted)
                editText.setSelection(formatted.length)
                editText.addTextChangedListener(this)

            }

            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
        }
    }


    private fun showDatePicker(editText: TextInputEditText, restrictFutureDates: Boolean) {
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()
        val datePicker = DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, year, month, dayOfMonth ->
                val selectedDate = Calendar.getInstance().apply {
                    set(year, month, dayOfMonth)
                }.time
                val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
                editText.setText(sdf.format(selectedDate))
            },
            calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        )

        if (restrictFutureDates) {
            datePicker.datePicker.maxDate = System.currentTimeMillis()
        }

        datePicker.show()
    }


    private fun checkPermissionsAndOpenCamera() {
        val cameraPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val locationPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

        if (cameraPermission && locationPermission) {
            openCamera()
        } else {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(
                this,
                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CAMERA, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION),
                PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE
            )
        }
    }

    private fun openCamera() {
        val intent = Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE)
        try {
            photoFile = createImageFile()
            val authority = "$packageName.fileprovider"
            val photoUri: Uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, authority, photoFile!!)
            intent.putExtra(MediaStore.EXTRA_OUTPUT, photoUri)
            intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            startActivityForResult(intent, CAMERA_REQUEST_CODE)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Camera Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    private fun createImageFile(): File {
        val timeStamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
        val storageDir = getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES)
        return File.createTempFile("IMG_${timeStamp}_", ".jpg", storageDir)
    }

    @RequiresPermission(allOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)

        if (requestCode == CAMERA_REQUEST_CODE && resultCode == RESULT_OK && photoFile != null) {
            // Process captured image with location
            fetchLocationAndOverlayImage()

            // Enable previously disabled fields after photo is stored
            enableFieldsAfterPhoto()
        }
    }

    @RequiresPermission(anyOf = [Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION])
    private fun fetchLocationAndOverlayImage() {
        if (ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Location permission not granted", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        fusedLocationClient.lastLocation.addOnSuccessListener { location ->
            if (location != null) {
                latitude = location.latitude
                longitude = location.longitude
                fullAddress = getAddressFromLocation(latitude, longitude)

                val currentDate = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()) // 👈 dash format
                val currentTime = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
                currentDateTime = currentDate

                binding.etLat.setText(latitude.toString())
                binding.etLong.setText(longitude.toString())
                binding.etDate.setText(currentDate) // 👈 dd-MM-yyyy
                binding.etVisitTime.setText(currentTime)
                binding.etAddress.setText(fullAddress)

                overlayImage(photoFile!!.absolutePath)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Unable to fetch location", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }


    private fun getAddressFromLocation(lat: Double, lon: Double): String {
        return try {
            val geocoder = Geocoder(this, Locale.getDefault())
            val addresses = geocoder.getFromLocation(lat, lon, 1)
            if (!addresses.isNullOrEmpty()) addresses[0].getAddressLine(0) else "Address not found"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            "Address not found"
        }
    }

    private fun overlayImage(imagePath: String) {
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imagePath)
        val mutableBitmap = bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, true)
        val canvas = Canvas(mutableBitmap)

        val paint = Paint().apply {
            color = Color.WHITE
            textSize = 50f
            isAntiAlias = true
            setShadowLayer(10f, 5f, 5f, Color.BLACK)
        }

        val bgPaint = Paint().apply {
            color = Color.parseColor("#88000000")
            style = Paint.Style.FILL
        }

        val lines = listOf(
            "📍 $fullAddress",
            "📅 $currentDateTime",
            "🌐 Lat: $latitude",
            "🌐 Long: $longitude"
        )

        val x = 30f
        val yStart = mutableBitmap.height - lines.size * 80f - 30f

        canvas.drawRect(0f, yStart - 40f, mutableBitmap.width.toFloat(), mutableBitmap.height.toFloat(), bgPaint)

        var y = yStart
        lines.forEach {
            canvas.drawText(it, x, y, paint)
            y += 80f
        }

        saveBitmapToGallery(mutableBitmap)
        binding.profilePhoto.setImageBitmap(mutableBitmap)
    }

    private fun saveBitmapToGallery(bitmap: Bitmap) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                val contentValues = ContentValues().apply {
                    put(MediaStore.Images.Media.DISPLAY_NAME, "IMG_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
                    put(MediaStore.Images.Media.MIME_TYPE, "image/jpeg")
                    put(MediaStore.Images.Media.RELATIVE_PATH, "${Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES}/VisitApp")
                }

                val uri = contentResolver.insert(MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, contentValues)
                uri?.let {
                    contentResolver.openOutputStream(it)?.use { out ->
                        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, out)
                    }
                }
            } else {
                val dir = File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES), "VisitApp")
                if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs()
                val file = File(dir, "IMG_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
                FileOutputStream(file).use { out ->
                    bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, out)
                }
                sendBroadcast(Intent(Intent.ACTION_MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE, Uri.fromFile(file)))
            }
            Toast.makeText(this, "Image saved with location", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Save failed: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode: Int, permissions: Array<out String>, grantResults: IntArray) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE && grantResults.all { it == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }) {
            openCamera()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Permissions are required", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }




}

package com.avs.visitapp

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.app.DatePickerDialog
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.text.Editable
import android.text.TextWatcher
import android.view.*
import android.widget.*
import androidx.annotation.RequiresApi
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.avs.visitapp.Adapter.VisitAdapter
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.DialogLoadingBinding
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.VisitRecordActivityBinding
import retrofit2.Call
import retrofit2.Callback
import retrofit2.Response
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.*

class VisitRecordActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: VisitRecordActivityBinding
    private var loadingDialog: AlertDialog? = null

    private val fromCalendar = Calendar.getInstance()
    private val toCalendar = Calendar.getInstance()

    private val displayDateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd-MM-yyyy", Locale.US)
    private val apiDateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US)

    private var fromDateApi: String? = null
    private var toDateApi: String? = null

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = VisitRecordActivityBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }

        binding.visitRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)

        binding.etFromDate.setOnClickListener { showDatePicker(isFrom = true) }
//        binding.etToDate.setOnClickListener { showDatePicker(isFrom = false) }

        binding.etMobile.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                val mobile = s.toString()
                if (mobile.length == 10 && mobile.all { it.isDigit() }) {
                    binding.etMobile.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this@VisitRecordActivity, android.R.color.black))
                    binding.tilMobile.error = null
                } else {
                    binding.etMobile.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this@VisitRecordActivity, android.R.color.holo_red_dark))
                    binding.tilMobile.error = "Enter valid 10-digit mobile number"
                }
            }
        })

        binding.btnSubmit.setOnClickListener {
            val mobile = binding.etMobile.text.toString().trim()
            val empId = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_ID, "")

            when {
                mobile.isEmpty() -> {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Enter mobile number", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return@setOnClickListener
                }
                fromDateApi.isNullOrEmpty() -> {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Select From Date", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return@setOnClickListener
                }
            }

            val request = VisitRecordRequest(
                EmployeeId = empId,
                FromDate = fromDateApi!!,
//                ToDate = toDateApi,
                MobileNo = mobile
            )

            fetchVisitData(request)
        }
    }

    private fun showDatePicker(isFrom: Boolean) {
        val calendar = if (isFrom) fromCalendar else toCalendar

        val listener = DatePickerDialog.OnDateSetListener { _, year, month, dayOfMonth ->
            calendar.set(year, month, dayOfMonth)

            val formattedDisplayDate = displayDateFormat.format(calendar.time)
            val formattedApiDate = apiDateFormat.format(calendar.time)

            if (isFrom) {
                binding.etFromDate.setText(formattedDisplayDate)
                fromDateApi = formattedApiDate
            }
//            else {
//                binding.etToDate.setText(formattedDisplayDate)
//                toDateApi = formattedApiDate
//            }
        }

        DatePickerDialog(
            this, listener,
            calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        ).show()
    }

    private fun fetchVisitData(request: VisitRecordRequest) {
        showLoadingDialog()

        ApiClient.apiService.getVisitsByEmployeeId(request)
            .enqueue(object : Callback<VisitRetrieveResponse> {
                @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
                override fun onResponse(
                    call: Call<VisitRetrieveResponse>,
                    response: Response<VisitRetrieveResponse>
                ) {
                    dismissLoadingDialog()
                    val visitList = response.body()?.data
                    if (response.isSuccessful && visitList?.isNotEmpty() == true) {
                        val reversedList = visitList.reversed()
                        val adapter = VisitAdapter(reversedList) { selectedVisit ->
                            showVisitDetailsDialog(selectedVisit)
                        }
                        binding.visitRecyclerView.adapter = adapter
                        binding.filterLayout.visibility = View.GONE
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this@VisitRecordActivity, "No visit records found", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        binding.visitRecyclerView.adapter = null
                    }
                }

                override fun onFailure(call: Call<VisitRetrieveResponse>, t: Throwable) {
                    dismissLoadingDialog()
                    val errorMsg = if (t.message?.contains("Unable to resolve host") == true)
                        "No internet connection"
                    else
                        "Error: ${t.localizedMessage}"
                    Toast.makeText(this@VisitRecordActivity, errorMsg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            })
    }

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    private fun formatDate(dateStr: String?): String {
        return try {
            val date = LocalDate.parse(dateStr?.substring(0, 10))
            date.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd-MM-yyyy"))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            "N/A"
        }
    }

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    private fun formatTime(timeStr: String?): String {
        return try {
            val time = LocalTime.parse(timeStr)
            time.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("hh:mm:ss a"))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            "N/A"
        }
    }

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    @SuppressLint("MissingInflatedId")
    private fun showVisitDetailsDialog(data: VisitData) {
        val inflater = LayoutInflater.from(this)
        val dialogView = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_visit_details, null)
        val buttonView = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_visit_buttons, null)

        val formattedAppDate = formatDate(data.Applicant?.ApplicationDate)
        val formattedVisitDate = formatDate(data.Visit?.VisitDate)
        val formattedVisitTime = formatTime(data.Visit?.VisitTime)

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvName).text = data.Applicant?.Name ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMobile).text = data.OccupationDetails?.MobileNo ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAppDate).text = formattedAppDate
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvLoanPurpose).text = data.Applicant?.LoanPurposeType ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvRequestedAmount).text = data.Applicant?.RequestedAmount?.toString() ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvSerialNo).text = data.Applicant?.ApplicationSerialNo ?: "N/A"

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvBankName).text = data.BankDetails?.BankName ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvBranchName).text = data.BankDetails?.BranchName ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAccountNo).text = data.BankDetails?.AccountNumber ?: "N/A"

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvFamilyIncome).text = "₹ ${data.FamilyIncome?.TotalIncome ?: "0"}"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMonthlyIncome).text = "₹ ${data.OccupationDetails?.MonthlyIncome ?: "0"}"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAgriLand).text = data.OccupationDetails?.AgriculturalLand ?: "N/A"

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvVisitDate).text = formattedVisitDate
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvVisitTime).text = formattedVisitTime
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvPersonName).text = data.Visit?.PresentPersonName ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvVisitMobile).text = data.Visit?.VMobileNo ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAddress).text = data.Visit?.ResidentialAddress ?: "N/A"

        val customTitle = TextView(this).apply {
            text = "Visit Details"
            setPadding(40, 30, 40, 30)
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            textSize = 20f
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#4fc1c2"))
        }

        val contentLayout = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            )
            addView(dialogView)
            addView(buttonView)
        }

        val scrollView = ScrollView(this).apply {
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            )
            addView(contentLayout)
        }

        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setCustomTitle(customTitle)
            .setView(scrollView)
            .create()

        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            val btnDownload = buttonView.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnDownload)
            val btnClose = buttonView.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnClose)

            btnDownload.setOnClickListener {
//                generateVisitPDF(this@VisitRecordActivity, data)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }

            btnClose.setOnClickListener {
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private fun showLoadingDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogLoadingBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        val builder = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
        builder.setView(dialogBinding.root)
        builder.setCancelable(false)
        dialogBinding.tvLoading.text = "Loading visit records..."
        loadingDialog = builder.create()
        loadingDialog?.show()
    }

    private fun dismissLoadingDialog() {
        try {
            if (loadingDialog?.isShowing == true) {
                loadingDialog?.dismiss()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }
}

package com.avs.visitapp

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.app.DatePickerDialog
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import android.view.*
import android.widget.*
import androidx.annotation.RequiresApi
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.view.setPadding
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.avs.visitapp.Adapter.VisitAdapter
import com.avs.visitapp.Adapter.VisitReportAdapter
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.DialogLoadingBinding
import com.avs.visitapp.databinding.VisitReportActivityBinding
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.*

class VisitReportActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: VisitReportActivityBinding
    private lateinit var adapter: VisitReportAdapter
    private var loadingDialog: AlertDialog? = null
    private var fromDate: String? = null
    private var toDate: String? = null
    private var isFromDate = true
    private var fullVisitList: List<VisitData> = listOf()

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = VisitReportActivityBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }



        binding.visitRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)

//        fetchVisitRecords()

        binding.btnFrom.setOnClickListener {
            isFromDate = true
            showDatePickerDialog()
        }

        binding.btnTo.setOnClickListener {
            isFromDate = false
            showDatePickerDialog()
        }

    }

    private fun showLoadingDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogLoadingBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        val builder = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
        builder.setView(dialogBinding.root)
        builder.setCancelable(false)
        dialogBinding.tvLoading.text = "Loading visit records..."
        loadingDialog = builder.create()
        loadingDialog?.show()
    }

    private fun dismissLoadingDialog() {
        loadingDialog?.dismiss()
    }

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    private fun fetchVisitRecords() {
        val emp_id = Constant.getSharedPreference(this, Constant.SHARE_EMP_ID, "")

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            showLoadingDialog()
            try {
                val response = ApiClient.apiService.getVisitsByEmployeeId(id = emp_id)
                if (response.isSuccessful && response.body() != null) {

                    // ✅ Reverse the list to show latest visits first
                    fullVisitList = response.body()!!.data.reversed()


                    val nullVisitCount = fullVisitList.count { it.Visit == null }

                    showTodayVisits()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this@VisitReportActivity, "No data found", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {

                e.printStackTrace()
                Toast.makeText(this@VisitReportActivity, "Failed to fetch visits", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            } finally {
                dismissLoadingDialog()
            }
        }
    }


    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    private fun showTodayVisits() {
        val today = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())

        val todayList = fullVisitList.filter {
            val date = it.Visit?.VisitDate?.substring(0, 10)
            Log.d("VisitFilter", "Checking date: $date vs $today")
            date == today
        }

        adapter = VisitReportAdapter(todayList) { visitData ->
            showVisitDetailsDialog(visitData)
        }
        binding.visitRecyclerView.adapter = adapter
    }

    @SuppressLint("DefaultLocale")
    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    private fun showDatePickerDialog() {
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance()
        val datePicker = DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, year, month, dayOfMonth ->
                // Internally store in yyyy-MM-dd (for filtering)
                val internalDate = String.format("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month + 1, dayOfMonth)
                // Display in dd-MM-yyyy
                val displayDate = String.format("%02d-%02d-%04d", dayOfMonth, month + 1, year)

                if (isFromDate) {
                    fromDate = internalDate
                    binding.btnFrom.text = displayDate
                } else {
                    toDate = internalDate
                    binding.btnTo.text = displayDate
                }
                filterVisitsByDateRange()
            },
            calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        )
        datePicker.show()
    }


    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    private fun filterVisitsByDateRange() {
        if (fromDate.isNullOrEmpty() || toDate.isNullOrEmpty()) return

        val formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd")
        val from = LocalDate.parse(fromDate, formatter)
        val to = LocalDate.parse(toDate, formatter)

        val filteredList = fullVisitList.filter {
            val visitDateStr = it.Visit?.VisitDate?.substring(0, 10)
            visitDateStr != null && run {
                val visitDate = LocalDate.parse(visitDateStr, formatter)
                (visitDate >= from && visitDate <= to)
            }
        }

        adapter = VisitReportAdapter(filteredList) { visitData ->
            showVisitDetailsDialog(visitData)
        }
        binding.visitRecyclerView.adapter = adapter
    }


    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    @SuppressLint("MissingInflatedId")
    private fun showVisitDetailsDialog(data: VisitData) {
        val inflater = LayoutInflater.from(this)
        val dialogView = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_visit_details, null)
        val buttonView = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_visit_buttons, null)

        val formattedAppDate = formatDate(data.Applicant.ApplicationDate)
        val formattedVisitDate = formatDate(data.Visit?.VisitDate)
        val formattedVisitTime = formatTime(data.Visit?.VisitTime)

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvName).text = data.Applicant.Name
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMobile).text = data.OccupationDetails.MobileNo
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAppDate).text = formattedAppDate
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvLoanPurpose).text = data.Applicant.LoanPurposeType
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvRequestedAmount).text = data.Applicant.RequestedAmount.toString()
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvSerialNo).text = data.Applicant.ApplicationSerialNo

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvBankName).text = data.BankDetails.BankName
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvBranchName).text = data.BankDetails.BranchName
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAccountNo).text = data.BankDetails.AccountNumber

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvFamilyIncome).text = "₹ ${data.FamilyIncome.TotalIncome}"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMonthlyIncome).text = "₹ ${data.OccupationDetails.MonthlyIncome}"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAgriLand).text = data.OccupationDetails.AgriculturalLand

        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvVisitDate).text = formattedVisitDate
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvVisitTime).text = formattedVisitTime
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvPersonName).text = data.Visit?.PresentPersonName ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvVisitMobile).text = data.Visit?.VMobileNo ?: "N/A"
        dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAddress).text = data.Visit?.ResidentialAddress ?: "N/A"

        val customTitle = TextView(this).apply {
            text = "Visit Details"
            setPadding(40, 30, 40, 30)
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            textSize = 20f
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#4fc1c2"))
        }

        val contentLayout = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            )
            addView(dialogView)
            addView(buttonView)
        }

        val scrollView = ScrollView(this).apply {
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            )
            addView(contentLayout)
        }

        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setCustomTitle(customTitle)
            .setView(scrollView)
            .create()

        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            val btnDownload = buttonView.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnDownload)
            val btnClose = buttonView.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnClose)

            btnDownload.setOnClickListener {
                dialog.dismiss()
            }

            btnClose.setOnClickListener {
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private fun formatDate(dateString: String?): String {
        return try {
            val inputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault())
            val date = inputFormat.parse(dateString ?: "")
            val outputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
            outputFormat.format(date ?: Date())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            dateString ?: "N/A"
        }
    }

    private fun formatTime(timeString: String?): String {
        return try {
            val inputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
            val time = inputFormat.parse(timeString ?: "")
            val outputFormat = SimpleDateFormat("hh:mm a", Locale.getDefault())
            outputFormat.format(time ?: Date())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            timeString ?: "N/A"
        }
    }


}

#!/usr/bin/env sh

#
# Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#

##############################################################################
##
##  Gradle start up script for UN*X
##
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME
# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
PRG="$0"
# Need this for relative symlinks.
while [ -h "$PRG" ] ; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
    if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
        PRG="$link"
    else
        PRG=`dirname "$PRG"`"/$link"
    fi
done
SAVED="`pwd`"
cd "`dirname \"$PRG\"`/" >/dev/null
APP_HOME="`pwd -P`"
cd "$SAVED" >/dev/null

APP_NAME="Gradle"
APP_BASE_NAME=`basename "$0"`

# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD="maximum"

warn () {
    echo "$*"
}

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
}

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "`uname`" in
  CYGWIN* )
    cygwin=true
    ;;
  Darwin* )
    darwin=true
    ;;
  MINGW* )
    msys=true
    ;;
  NONSTOP* )
    nonstop=true
    ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
    else
        JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD="java"
    which java >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if [ "$cygwin" = "false" -a "$darwin" = "false" -a "$nonstop" = "false" ] ; then
    MAX_FD_LIMIT=`ulimit -H -n`
    if [ $? -eq 0 ] ; then
        if [ "$MAX_FD" = "maximum" -o "$MAX_FD" = "max" ] ; then
            MAX_FD="$MAX_FD_LIMIT"
        fi
        ulimit -n $MAX_FD
        if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit: $MAX_FD"
        fi
    else
        warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit: $MAX_FD_LIMIT"
    fi
fi

# For Darwin, add options to specify how the application appears in the dock
if $darwin; then
    GRADLE_OPTS="$GRADLE_OPTS \"-Xdock:name=$APP_NAME\" \"-Xdock:icon=$APP_HOME/media/gradle.icns\""
fi

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if [ "$cygwin" = "true" -o "$msys" = "true" ] ; then
    APP_HOME=`cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME"`
    CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH"`

    JAVACMD=`cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD"`

    # We build the pattern for arguments to be converted via cygpath
    ROOTDIRSRAW=`find -L / -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null`
    SEP=""
    for dir in $ROOTDIRSRAW ; do
        ROOTDIRS="$ROOTDIRS$SEP$dir"
        SEP="|"
    done
    OURCYGPATTERN="(^($ROOTDIRS))"
    # Add a user-defined pattern to the cygpath arguments
    if [ "$GRADLE_CYGPATTERN" != "" ] ; then
        OURCYGPATTERN="$OURCYGPATTERN|($GRADLE_CYGPATTERN)"
    fi
    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    i=0
    for arg in "$@" ; do
        CHECK=`echo "$arg"|egrep -c "$OURCYGPATTERN" -`
        CHECK2=`echo "$arg"|egrep -c "^-"`                                 ### Determine if an option

        if [ $CHECK -ne 0 ] && [ $CHECK2 -eq 0 ] ; then                    ### Added a condition
            eval `echo args$i`=`cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg"`
        else
            eval `echo args$i`="\"$arg\""
        fi
        i=`expr $i + 1`
    done
    case $i in
        0) set -- ;;
        1) set -- "$args0" ;;
        2) set -- "$args0" "$args1" ;;
        3) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" ;;
        4) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" ;;
        5) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" ;;
        6) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" ;;
        7) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" "$args6" ;;
        8) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" "$args6" "$args7" ;;
        9) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" "$args6" "$args7" "$args8" ;;
    esac
fi

# Escape application args
save () {
    for i do printf %s\\n "$i" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g;1s/^/'/;\$s/\$/' \\\\/" ; done
    echo " "
}
APP_ARGS=`save "$@"`

# Collect all arguments for the java command, following the shell quoting and substitution rules
eval set -- $DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS "\"-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME\"" -classpath "\"$CLASSPATH\"" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain "$APP_ARGS"

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

@rem
@rem Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.
@rem
@rem Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
@rem you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
@rem You may obtain a copy of the License at
@rem
@rem      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
@rem
@rem Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
@rem distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
@rem WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
@rem See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
@rem limitations under the License.
@rem

@if "%DEBUG%" == "" @echo off
@rem ##########################################################################
@rem
@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
@rem
@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%" == "" set DIRNAME=.
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%

@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if "%ERRORLEVEL%" == "0" goto execute

echo.
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.
echo.
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
echo location of your Java installation.

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute

echo.
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME%
echo.
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
echo location of your Java installation.

goto fail

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar


@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %*

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%ERRORLEVEL%"=="0" goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
if  not "" == "%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit 1
exit /b 1

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega
